articles.titleTr: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
articles.summaryTr: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.
articles.articleText: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion? - Published In 2015, a young male gorilla named Jojo took his first tentative steps onto grass. Until that moment, the 11-year-old ape had spent almost his entire life in a tiny cage at a private zoo in Gabon, after being taken from the wild as an infant. His family had been killed by the poachers who took him. More than a decade later, Jojo is settled into a sanctuary – but he still lives alone. He hasn't had a family since he was taken, or indeed any gorilla friends. Jojo's carers at the Lekedi Foundation in Gabon want to find a companion - possibly another rescued or zoo-bred gorilla – that Jojo could live and bond with. But finding him a friend - and bringing them into his life - is not straightforward. "He's probably the most extreme case of isolation I've ever seen in a great ape," says Prof Gillian Forrester from the University of Sussex, who is studying Jojo as part of research into great ape psychology and how to help rescued animals recover from trauma. Jojo was less than a year old – an infant clinging to his mother – when he was captured and sold. Most gorillas spend the first 14 to 19 years of their life in an embedded family unit but he was kept completely alone and on public display at the private zoo that bought him. Maxe Anaclet Makaba, who is head keeper at Lekedi and sees Jojo nearly every day, says it is clear he "craves human interaction". "He will even go to the trouble of gathering leaves for us to hold, so that we [trade them] for a treat – to interact with us," he says. Jojo also calls out when women he knows well visit his enclosure and then leave, making sounds that silverback males use to summon the females in the wild, explains Éric Willaume, who runs the sanctuary. "He definitely feels lonely," he says. Jojo is one of the more than 6,000 African primates estimated to have been bought or sold in the global trade of apes and other primates between 2000 and 2023. Thousands more are trafficked illegally for use as exotic pets, wild meat, and traditional medicine, the Pan African Sanctuary Alliance says., external Experts believe when baby great apes are taken from their group at a young age like Jojo, they are left traumatised. "If they're old enough to understand what happened to them, to understand their family was killed, they just lose the will to live," explains conservationist Tony King, from UK charity the Aspinall Foundation. "You see it in their eyes – the light goes out. I never knew where that expression came from, but I've seen it in gorillas." King – who specialises in rehabilitating rescued great apes – remembers rescuing two infant sister gorillas who were brought to a sanctuary in the Congo Basin. "They were clinging to each other," he says. "They stayed together in a little tight ball for about three days before they sort of unravelled. I think that's what kept them alive." African charity the Gorilla Rehabilitation and Conservation Education (Grace) Center uses what it calls "gorilla-led" rehabilitation. When the team rescues a young gorilla from the pet trade, they put it with a group as soon as possible so they can socialise and essentially learn to be a gorilla. But Jojo's case is unusual. He is fully mature and showing signs of harmful, chronic stress, according to Forrester. In a game-changing approach to studying anxiety and trauma in apes, she has used a thermal camera to film Jojo's face. This allows her to monitor blood flow, revealing what appears to be a chronically cold nose. It's a sign of a malfunctioning stress response. When any primate – a human, chimp or gorilla - is stressed, blood flow to the eyes and ears increases. It puts them on high alert for danger, but leaves their nose, temporarily, colder. For Jojo, this "nasal dip" as it is known, does not seem to recover. "Being connected to others is incredibly important to our psychology as great apes," Forrester says. "Having another individual to share his life with would be so healing for him. "I would assume other gorillas would help him process this grief and trauma." Dr Katie Fawcett, from the Grace Center, says it's also "essential" for an animal to form social relationships to be considered for release into the wild - which is the ultimate goal for Jojo's keepers. The bonds between gorillas – what we would call friendship - is key to their society, adds Dr Robin Morrison from the University of Zurich, who studies the social lives of mountain gorillas. In one recent study, she discovered that female mountain gorillas would seek out females they knew, even if they hadn't seen them for many years, when joining a group. And she says a big part of a gorilla's normal social life is "just sitting together quietly sharing space". But Jojo has never been given the opportunity to sit quietly with another gorilla. No one knows how Jojo will react to a companion. Moving an animal from an accredited zoo would be a decision for an international committee and based on genetics, health and the animals' personalities and compatibility. Any introduction to another animal would be done very carefully – perhaps giving them an object that smells of the other before they see each other. These slow, cautious ape introductions do happen – when an animal moves from one zoo group to another, for example. Forrester has contacted a number of accredited zoos to explore the possibility of doing this for Jojo. But those discussions have fizzled out with no sign of progress. The problem, she says, is "there aren't clear processes in place to do these kinds of trans-locations". The international rules and processes for moving captive gorillas across international borders - from one zoo or safari park to another - are designed for breeding programmes. "They're not designed for reintroductions into the wild, or to find companions for animals that might need them," says Forrester. And because Jojo, who is probably in his 20s, has reached maturity, King thinks it might be too late for him to bond with other gorillas. "Jojo's situation is unique, but he is probably best where he is," King says, adding that introducing him to another animal could, somewhat ironically, be a source of more stress for him. Being alone is also natural, even relatively common, for mature male gorillas. According to Morrison, about a third of adult males are solitary. "When they reach adolescence, they tend to disperse and spend a good chunk of their life on their own." Solo males will try to persuade females to form a group with them, but some don't succeed and may feel lonely as a consequence, Morrison believes. "If we think of loneliness in an evolutionary context - this mismatch between the social interactions they want and the social interactions they're getting. I suspect feeling lonely is part of the natural, evolutionary drive to attract females." But while those phases – of family life and adult solitude - play a role in wild gorilla society, Jojo was forced into solitary confinement as an infant. Morrison believes Jojo is probably both traumatised and lonely. "[In the wild] gorillas move together, find food together, sleep together," she says. "So much of their lives is just being with this group." That is what Jojo's keepers, Forrester, and others want for Jojo. A friend. Maybe a female, or a compatible male. "It would be good for him to have a companion," says keeper Makaba. "Because being alone is like being cut off from the world - it's like being in prison. "Having another gorilla there would be a good thing for him." Related topics - Published20 April 2025 - Published7 January

articles.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
articles.summary: Elon Musk’s company aborted an attempted catch of the rocket’s booster - instead it came down in the ocean.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
articles.summaryTr: Elon Musk’s company aborted an attempted catch of the rocket’s booster - instead it came down in the ocean.
articles.articleText: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test - Published SpaceX aborted its attempt to catch the bottom part of its huge Starship rocket during its latest test flight. The aim was to catch it using the mechanical arms - nicknamed chopsticks - on the launch tower as it returned to Earth, but instead it was diverted to the ocean, bursting into flames as it came down. The top part of the rocket is now continuing its journey to space, and SpaceX will decide whether it will try to catch this rocket stage - at about 1515 local time (2115 GMT) on Saturday. It's the company's first attempt to fully recover its rocket, paving the way for making Starship fully reusable so it can fly repeatedly and reduce costs. The 124m-tall rocket successfully blasted off from the Starbase launchpad in Boca Chica, Texas at 1645 local time (2245 GMT) on Friday. It was supposed to catch the bottom part of the rocket - the Super Heavy booster - six and a half minutes later when it returned to the launch tower, but instead it was diverted to the ocean. During a stream of the launch, a SpaceX spokesperson said: "Safety is always the number one priority, and we're still testing out things that we haven't done before on these vehicles, and so we are prioritising making sure that we can perform each maneuver safely." The top part of the rocket, called the Ship, is continuing its journey to space, where it is deploying 26 satellites. These will form part of the Starlink constellation that provides high-speed internet from space. The Ship is due to complete 14 orbits around the Earth before returning to the launch tower 22.5 hours after taking off, where a second catch may be attempted. Until now, SpaceX has managed to catch the Super Heavy Booster on three earlier test flights. But the upper stage of the rocket, which only reached orbit for the first time in September, has never been grabbed by the chopsticks. Instead it's splashed down in the ocean. Before the flight, SpaceX said it would only decide to try to catch the Ship after carefully assessing the vehicle while it's in space. If any problems are detected there are various points during the flight when the rocket stage can be brought down in the ocean. Building a fully reusable rocket is a long-held ambition for SpaceX. In 2015, it became the first company to vertically land part of a rocket with its Falcon 9 booster. Falcon 9 rockets now fly more than a hundred times a year, and the ability to reuse the bottom part of the rocket has dramatically cut the costs of launch. But landing an entire Starship rocket could take this to the next level, says Prof Malcolm Macdonald, President of Royal Aeronautical Society. "Full reusability has the potential to fundamentally change the economics of accessing space," he said. "One successful flight will not prove that model, but it could mark an important transition: from demonstrating that Starship can fly, to demonstrating how Starship could operate." - What is Nasa's Artemis III mission? And what comes next? - Published27 October - Watch: From launch to fiery splashdown, SpaceX's Starship completes orbit test - Published28 September After SpaceX went public earlier this year, its shareholders will be carefully monitoring this flight, as will the US Space Agency. The progress of Starship has direct implications for Nasa's attempt to land humans on the Moon in 2028 - a highly ambitious timeline. SpaceX has been given a Nasa contract to configure the Ship into a lander that will eventually take astronauts down to the lunar surface. But it's not the only company working with the US Space Agency. Blue Origin, owned by rival tech billionaire Jeff Bezos, also has a contract to use its New Glenn rocket and lander for the Moon touch down. Both companies will also play a key role in Artemis III, which is currently planned for summer 2027- another challenging schedule. This mission will see four astronauts in Nasa's Orion spacecraft attempt to dock with both SpaceX and Blue Origin's landers. Starship will need to make a lot of progress in the coming months to meet these commitments - the pace of the rocket's development has been far slower than SpaceX had intended. But Blue Origin also has much work to do. The company suffered a major setback earlier this year when its rocket exploded, totally destroying its launchpad in Florida. Blue Origin had said they would be back in action by the end of this year, but a return to flight has now been delayed to early in 2027. Nasa is under pressure to meet its timelines. Its administrator Jared Isaacman has said America is in a race with China to get to the Moon. China plans to land its Taikonauts on the lunar surface by 2030.

articles.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All rescued after cruise ship hit by tanker in New Orleans
articles.summary: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All rescued after cruise ship hit by tanker in New Orleans
articles.summaryTr: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.
articles.articleText: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All rescued after cruise ship hit by tanker in New Orleans - Published Some 130 people on a cruise ship docked in New Orleans have been rescued after it was struck by a tanker. The cruise ship, American Heritage, was left lying on its side in the Mississippi River after it was hit by the cargo vessel, Atlantic Asphalt. The collision left 32 people from the stricken riverboat in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for. Officials hailed it as a "miracle on the Mississippi". The exact cause of the crash remains under investigation, but US Coast Guard Captain Melanie Burnham said: "There seems to be some type of a loss of steering." New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno told a news conference that all credit in the rescue effort went to first responders who "literally jumped right in to help". "We have zero people unaccounted for which truly is a miracle on the Mississippi," Moreno said. Calls about the collision came in around 13:30 EST (18:30 GMT) on Friday when people began trying to help passengers escape the boat as it took on water, Port of New Orleans Chief Melanie Montroll told a news conference. There were about 129 passengers, in addition to crew members, on the American Heritage at the time of the collision, according to Port of New Orleans. Passengers began disembarking from the paddlewheeler vessel, operated by American Cruise Lines, as it started listing before tipping on to its side, Mayor Moreno said. Tugboat operators, police and other rescuers rushed to help and officials shut down the Mississippi River for the search effort. The American Heritage was finishing an eight-day cruise to Mississippi River destinations in Louisiana and Mississippi. President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social that the rescue was an "incredible job". Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin said the US Coast Guard also supported local rescue operations. Governor Jeff Landry also hailed the rescue as a "miracle on the Mississippi" given the "sheer number of people who were on that cruise ship" who were rescued. Ships have operated safely on the Mississippi River for years, Landry said, pledging to investigate what happened. Jamie Holford, a witness to the crash, told the BBC's US partner CBS that he saw the cruise ship hit the dock following the collision. "It sounded like a war movie. Just imagine tons of steel crunching. That's what it sounded like," he said. "It looked like something off the Titanic." Holford added that he saw passengers and crew members "hollering" and "crying" as they tried to get off the ship while it was sinking. The American Heritage can carry up to 150 guests and features a glass-enclosed restaurant, fitness centre and three guest lounges, according to its website. Built in 2015, the vessel has at least four decks.

articles.articleText: How the Jensen Huang scandal created a headache for business-friendly Singapore - Published A major scandal involving Nvidia founder Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy based in Singapore has cast a spotlight on the city-state's success as a global chip hub - and a location for alleged illicit trade. On Thursday, Huang stepped down from the US chip giant after admitting he had an affair. He was reportedly involved with a woman named Alice Huang, who ran Singaporean data centre company Megaspeed, a major buyer of Nvidia's chips. For decades, Singapore has painstakingly cultivated a reputation as an open, business-friendly economy offering easy access to both the US and Chinese markets. With the AI boom, it has become a major hub for the trade of high-end semiconductor chips in recent years. Singapore was the second-largest billing centre globally last year for Nvidia, accounting for nearly a fifth of what the US chip giant earns. But notably, less than 1% of its earnings were for chips that actually entered Singapore, as the island acts as a hub for many Asian companies to place orders and send them elsewhere. Since 2022, when the US restricted advanced American semiconductors from being exported to China or acquired by Chinese companies, US officials have been concerned that other countries such as Singapore could be used by Chinese companies to gain access to the chips. Megaspeed is a case in point. It became the biggest buyer of Nvidia's chips in South East Asia and is suspected of giving backdoor access to these chips to Chinese companies via its data centres in Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand. While Singapore does not prohibit the transfer of advanced AI chips to companies abroad, such moves can breach US export controls. Singapore has said that while it does not enforce "unilateral export controls imposed by other countries" it expects all companies in its jurisdiction to respect such regulations. The city-state has had some success in policing this. It has charged four companies and five individuals - including Chinese nationals - for various offences including fraud, following US concerns that Chinese AI company DeepSeek had been buying Nvidia chips from third parties in Singapore, among other places. They also tried to probe Megaspeed, but were faced with a number of difficulties. In a statement released on Thursday, the government said that since February 2025, they had been looking into whether Megaspeed and other firms had made false declarations about data servers which were purchased and exported through Singapore. The companies stated the equipment would end up in neighbouring Malaysia, but Singapore authorities suspect the equipment's final destinations were elsewhere. Singapore said it sought assistance from US authorities several times to get more information from one of the investigated companies - Supermicro, a US-based company which the BBC understands was supplying computer servers to Megaspeed. But "despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance", it said in its statement. The BBC has sought comment from the US State Department. Singapore authorities said they had also investigated Alice Huang - not for espionage, but for any possible role in Megaspeed's suspected fraud. In the end, they found "insufficient evidence" of crime and let her leave Singapore in February this year, after holding her passport for several months. Since launching their probe nearly two years ago, Singapore has yet to bring any charges against Megaspeed or any of the companies and individuals linked to the case. Singapore and US investigations into Megaspeed are still ongoing. In 2024, US officials had paid a visit to a Malaysian data centre owned by Megaspeed and saw Nvidia technology still in their boxes, raising concerns that Megaspeed was shipping high-end chips out elsewhere, according to a report by the New York Times. Last year, Megaspeed appeared to have imported 50,000 more chips than Nvidia could account for, according to a Bloomberg report. Nvidia later adjusted its own figures after visiting more warehouses. Megaspeed has maintained it has always acted lawfully and that previous inspections by authorities found no evidence of illegal activity. On Thursday, the company said it "welcomes appropriate government scrutiny" and that it is "committed to working constructively and transparently with the US government". China has also long refuted accusations that its companies and institutions are illegally obtaining high-end US chips. How Megaspeed and Alice Huang came to Singapore highlights other vulnerabilities stemming from the city-state's openness. In recent years, the city-state has become a prime destination for Chinese companies, with tech firms such as TikTok and Manus making it their global headquarters. Besides Singapore's ease of doing business, it has a population that is mostly ethnically Chinese and largely views China positively. For a Chinese firm, Singapore offers a base near the mainland and a "neutral address" that global customers and investors accept, said Winston Ma, adjunct professor at New York University's School of Law. But critics say this has given rise to "Singapore-washing", where Chinese companies use the city-state's clean image to obscure their origins, reduce suspicions and even cover up dubious activities. Washington-based security analysis group C4ADS told the BBC they had assessed Alice Huang's setup of Megaspeed to be such a case. BBC checks of corporate records in China, Hong Kong and Singapore found that in 2019, Huang sold a gaming company and its subsidiaries to Chinese gaming firm 7Road. In March 2023, a 7Road subsidiary in Singapore named Huang as its executive director. The next day it changed its name - to Megaspeed. Huang was in charge for eight months before she transferred the company to a Singaporean man. During this period, Megaspeed went through "a critical period of corporate restructuring and regional expansion", and her corporate relationships raised questions about whether "Megaspeed's Singaporean identity is genuine or effectively Chinese-controlled", according to C4ADS. Even after she transferred Megaspeed, C4ADS assessed that she was still "practically in control" of the company, based on her links to Megaspeed via another company as well as LinkedIn posts where she continued to identify herself as Megaspeed's "chairwoman" at conferences. Megaspeed has not answered BBC queries regarding the company's and Alice Huang's links to China and the Chinese government. All this reinforces the dilemma faced by Singapore. "For the longest time, Singapore has managed to enjoy the best of both worlds with excellent relations with US and China," Nanyang Technological University politics and international studies lecturer Dylan Loh said. Singapore has long positioned itself as a neutral party between the two superpowers. Its prime minister Lawrence Wong has insisted that his country is neither pro-China nor pro-America, but "pro-Singapore". But Loh says this balancing act "has now fast become very difficult to manage and sometimes quite fraught too" with the US-China dispute over chips. With the Megaspeed case, the tightrope Singapore has walked is set to get even narrower, according to analysts. Beijing may ask why Singapore is investigating issues pertaining to US restrictions and whether they are siding with the US' interests, says Chong Ja Ian, a Singaporean political scientist and non-resident scholar with Carnegie China. Washington, in turn, might read Singapore's latest statement as "pushing blame" on the US, which could lead to backlash from the White House, he said. "Singapore has made a policy position not to take sides. But by not choosing a side, they run the risk of being seen as complicit" in either side's agenda, he said. But Benjamin Ho, an assistant professor and China expert at Singapore's S Rajaratnam School of International Studies, noted that this was "not the first or last time Singapore will be caught between the US and China". "This is the price that an open economy has to grapple with - you get caught in the middle when things turn sour." Additional reporting by Jack Lau of the BBC's Global China Unit. - Published22 hours ago - Published1 day ago

articles.articleText: Çalışma hayatında yeni dönem! 2027-2029 Adil Geçiş Planı yayımlandı - Türkiye'nin 2053 net sıfır emisyon hedefi doğrultusunda hazırlanan Ulusal Adil Geçiş Stratejisi ve Eylem Planı, Cumhurbaşkanlığı Genelgesi ile yürürlüğe girdi. - Plan kapsamında çalışanların yeni beceriler kazanması, istihdamın korunması ve dönüşümden etkilenen sektör ve bölgelerin desteklenmesi hedefleniyor. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’ın imzasını taşıyan genelge, Resmi Gazete’de yayımlandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 2027-2029 dönemini kapsayan strateji, iklim değişikliği ile yeşil ve dijital dönüşümün çalışma hayatı üzerindeki etkilerini yönetmeyi amaçlıyor. Genelgede, Türkiye’nin 2053 net sıfır emisyon hedefi doğrultusunda dönüşüm sürecinin kimseyi geride bırakmadan yürütülmesinin önemine dikkat çekildi. 2 Temmuz 2025 tarihli İklim Kanunu ile mevzuata giren adil geçiş yaklaşımının; çalışanların ve işletmelerin değişen koşullara uyum sağlamasını, yeni beceriler kazanmasını, insana yakışır işlerin artırılmasını ve sosyal korumanın güçlendirilmesini gerektirdiği belirtildi. Üç temel politika ekseni belirlendi Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı koordinasyonunda, ilgili paydaşların katılımıyla hazırlanan strateji üç temel eksene dayanıyor: Beceri uyumu: Çalışanların dönüşen iş gücü piyasasının ihtiyaçlarına uygun beceriler kazanması. Kapsayıcı dönüşüm: Yeşil ve dijital dönüşümün farklı sektör, bölge ve toplumsal gruplar üzerindeki etkilerinin gözetilmesi. Sosyal koruma ve toplumsal dayanıklılık: Dönüşüm sürecinde çalışanların ve toplumun desteklenmesi. Plan kapsamında öncelikli sektörlere yönelik sektörel politikalar da uygulanacak. Uygulama altı ayda bir raporlanacak Strateji ve Eylem Planı, Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı'nın resmi internet sitesinde yayımlanacak. Planın koordinasyon, izleme ve değerlendirme çalışmaları ilgili kamu kurumları ve sosyal tarafların katılımıyla Bakanlık tarafından yürütülecek. Eylem Planı'nda sorumlu olarak belirlenen kurum ve kuruluşlar, uygulamadaki gelişmeleri altı aylık dönemler halinde Bakanlığa bildirecek. Adil geçiş, düşük karbonlu ve çevre dostu ekonomiye geçiş sırasında çalışanların, işletmelerin ve bölgelerin olumsuz etkilenmesini önlemeyi amaçlayan politika yaklaşımıdır. Temel hedef, yeşil dönüşümün istihdam ve sosyal haklar üzerindeki maliyetlerini azaltırken yeni iş ve beceri fırsatları yaratmaktır.

articles.summary: Kamuda 4/B statüsünde görev yapan sözleşmeli personeli ilgilendiren yeni düzenleme Resmî Gazete’de yayımlandı. Disiplin cezalarından hastalık izinlerine, göreve başlama sürelerinden kurum içi yer değişikliklerine kadar birçok konuda yeni kurallar getirildi.

articles.titleTr: Sözleşmeli personele yeni dönem! Disiplin cezalarından izinlere birçok kural değişti
articles.summaryTr: Kamuda 4/B statüsünde görev yapan sözleşmeli personeli ilgilendiren yeni düzenleme Resmî Gazete’de yayımlandı. Disiplin cezalarından hastalık izinlerine, göreve başlama sürelerinden kurum içi yer değişikliklerine kadar birçok konuda yeni kurallar getirildi.
articles.articleText: Sözleşmeli personele yeni dönem! Disiplin cezalarından izinlere birçok kural değişti - Kamuda 4/B statüsünde görev yapan sözleşmeli personeli ilgilendiren yeni düzenleme Resmi Gazete’de yayımlandı. - Disiplin cezalarından hastalık izinlerine, göreve başlama sürelerinden kurum içi yer değişikliklerine kadar birçok konuda yeni kurallar getirildi. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın imzasıyla yayımlanan 11982 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı, 14 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yürürlüğe girdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 657 sayılı Devlet Memurları Kanunu'nun 4/B maddesi kapsamında çalışan sözleşmeli personelin çalışma koşullarını düzenleyen kararla mevcut esaslarda değişiklik yapıldı. Sözleşmeli personele disiplin cezaları uygulanacak Yeni düzenlemeyle sözleşmeli personelin disipline aykırı fiil ve davranışlarında devlet memurlarına uygulanan disiplin hükümlerinin kıyasen uygulanması kararlaştırıldı. Buna göre disiplin cezalarının belirlenmesi, yetkili merciler ve disiplin kurullarının işleyişinde memurlara ilişkin hükümler esas alınacak. Aylıktan kesme cezası ise personelin pozisyonuna bağlı ödemelerin toplamı üzerinden 1/30 ile 1/8 arasında uygulanabilecek. Kademe ilerlemesinin durdurulması ve daha ağır cezaları gerektiren fiillerde disiplin kurulu kararı alınacak. Personelin görevine, atamaya yetkili amirin onayıyla son verilebilecek. Hastalık izinleri ve rapor süreleri değişti Hastalık ve refakat izinlerinde, 657 sayılı Kanun'un 105'inci maddesindeki ilgili hükümler sözleşmeli personele de uygulanacak. SGK tarafından ödenen geçici iş göremezlik ödeneği ise personelin ücretinden düşülecek. Azami hastalık izni süresinin tamamlanmasının ardından göreve başlanmaması da sözleşmenin sona erdirilmesine ilişkin hükümler arasına eklendi. Göreve başlama sürelerine sınır getirildi Yeni kurallara göre aynı yerde göreve başlayacak personelin, tebliği izleyen iş günü içinde işe başlaması gerekecek. Başka bir yerde görevlendirilen personel ise tebliğ tarihinden itibaren 15 günü izleyen iş günü içinde görevine başlayacak. Belgeyle ispatlanabilen zorlayıcı nedenler dışında bu sürelere uyulmaması, sözleşmenin sona erdirilmesine neden olabilecek. Kurum içi yer değişikliğinde 3 yıl şartı 4/B kapsamında çalışan personelin kurum içi yer değişiklikleri de yeniden düzenlendi. Buna göre personelin işe başladığı tarihten itibaren aynı kurumda üç yıllık çalışma süresini tamamlayana kadar yapacağı yer değişikliklerinde belirlenen özel usul ve esaslar uygulanacak. Sözleşmeli personelin görevden uzaklaştırılmasında da devlet memurlarına ilişkin hükümler kıyasen geçerli olacak. Memur kadrosuna geçenlerin boş pozisyonları iptal edilecek Sözleşmeli personelin memur kadrosuna atanması halinde boşalan sözleşmeli personel pozisyonları, başka bir işleme gerek kalmaksızın iptal edilmiş sayılacak. İptal edilen pozisyonlar ilgili kamu personel bilgi sistemine bildirilecek. Eğitim ve ücret ödemelerinde yeni hükümler Düzenlemeyle sözleşmeli personelin temel eğitim, hazırlayıcı eğitim ve staj süreçlerinin görev yaptıkları kurumlar tarafından yürütülmesi kararlaştırıldı. Hizmet içi eğitimlerle personelin mesleki gelişiminin desteklenmesi de öngörüldü. Ücretlerin ay başında peşin ödenmesi uygulaması devam edecek. Memur kadrosuna atananlar, kendisine aylık bağlananlar ve hayatını kaybeden personel bu uygulamanın dışında tutulacak. Yeni düzenleme, 14 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yayımlanmasıyla yürürlüğe girdi.
articles.articleTextTr: Sözleşmeli personele yeni dönem! Disiplin cezalarından izinlere birçok kural değişti - Kamuda 4/B statüsünde görev yapan sözleşmeli personeli ilgilendiren yeni düzenleme Resmi Gazete’de yayımlandı. - Disiplin cezalarından hastalık izinlerine, göreve başlama sürelerinden kurum içi yer değişikliklerine kadar birçok konuda yeni kurallar getirildi. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın imzasıyla yayımlanan 11982 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı, 14 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yürürlüğe girdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 657 sayılı Devlet Memurları Kanunu'nun 4/B maddesi kapsamında çalışan sözleşmeli personelin çalışma koşullarını düzenleyen kararla mevcut esaslarda değişiklik yapıldı. Sözleşmeli personele disiplin cezaları uygulanacak Yeni düzenlemeyle sözleşmeli personelin disipline aykırı fiil ve davranışlarında devlet memurlarına uygulanan disiplin hükümlerinin kıyasen uygulanması kararlaştırıldı. Buna göre disiplin cezalarının belirlenmesi, yetkili merciler ve disiplin kurullarının işleyişinde memurlara ilişkin hükümler esas alınacak. Aylıktan kesme cezası ise personelin pozisyonuna bağlı ödemelerin toplamı üzerinden 1/30 ile 1/8 arasında uygulanabilecek. articles.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, OpenAI launched AI payments in ChatGPT, Jane Street nearly eightfold its Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings while trimming its BlackRock stake, and Trump nominated four SEC and CFTC commissioners, including a replacement for Hester Peirce. OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex OpenAI on Friday introduced a new feature allowing AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users directly within ChatGPT through existing payment networks, in collaboration with American Express, Mastercard and Visa. The wallet lets users authorize transactions using biometric verification, such as facial recognition or fingerprints. Payment networks generate tokenized card credentials for each approved purchase, keeping users’ actual card details from merchants and AI agents, the company said. The service is being rolled out to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US with eligible cards issued in the country. OpenAI said it plans to eventually support purchases within preset spending limits and other restrictions without requiring approval for each transaction. The launch comes as AI companies seek to move beyond product recommendations into executing transactions, potentially changing how consumers interact with online merchants. OpenAI said it is working with payment processors and fraud prevention firms to support AI purchases through existing checkout systems. Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT Jane Street’s share count in Fidelity’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) rose nearly eightfold in the third quarter, while its holdings in BlackRock’s fund fell 19%. The trading giant ended September with 7.01 million shares of Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC0, up from about 887,000 at the end of June. The position was worth $509 million on Sept. 30, according to its second-quarter and third-quarter filings. Jane Street’s holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) fell to 20.22 million shares from 24.88 million. A higher share price lifted the reported value of its stake to $957 million from $828 million. Jane Street was the largest reported institutional holder of BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF at the end of June after boosting its share count by 324% in Q2, according to 13F Pro. IBIT is the world’s largest spot Bitcoin ETF with $56 billion in net assets as of Thursday. The firm also added nearly 9 million shares (about $249 million) of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (ARKB), while more than doubling its holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) by 7.83 million shares (about $158 million). Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks US President Donald Trump has nominated Steven Levine to replace former Securities and Exchange Commission Commissioner Hester Peirce, one of the agency’s most prominent crypto advocates, as part of four nominations to fill vacancies at the SEC and Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The White House’s latest announcement on Thursday named two nominees each for the SEC and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, agencies whose decisions help shape US cryptocurrency regulation, among other functions. All four nominations require Senate confirmation. The nominations would replenish several commissioner roles. The SEC currently has only two of its five commissioner seats filled, while CFTC Chairman Michael Selig is the sole member of his agency’s five-seat commission. The nominations come weeks before Democrats are set to take control of the Senate in January, giving a narrow window for Republicans to confirm Trump’s picks.

The wallet lets users authorize transactions using biometric verification, such as facial recognition or fingerprints. The launch comes as AI companies seek to move beyond product recommendations into executing transactions, potentially changing how consumers interact with online merchants. OpenAI said it is working with payment processors and fraud prevention firms to support AI purchases through existing checkout systems. OpenAI joins a growing field of companies developing payment systems for AI agents. Google introduced its Agent Payments Protocol in 2025, while Visa and Mastercard have launched initiatives to support AI-initiated transactions. Crypto companies are also developing payment infrastructure for AI agents. Coinbase introduced its x402 protocol in 2025, enabling autonomous stablecoin payments for digital services, while Circle launched its Agent Stack in May, allowing agents to hold and spend USDC within predefined limits. Crossmint, which provides stablecoin infrastructure, has taken a different approach, combining stablecoin wallets with traditional card networks. Global agentic commerce transaction value is expected to reach $1.5 trillion by 2030, according to an April report from Juniper Research, up from an estimated $8 billion in 2026. articles.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
articles.summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
articles.summaryTr: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
articles.articleText: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks. Adam Back’s Bitcoin infrastructure company Blockstream has launched a new institutional digital asset custody solution developed with French technology group Thales, as the cryptographer pushes for simpler, offline security systems to protect Bitcoin against increasingly sophisticated cyberattacks. The solution, announced Friday, combines Thales’ hardware security modules (HSMs) with Blockstream’s Secure Multi-Party Computation (Secure-MPC) technology, allowing institutions to authorize transactions while keeping sensitive cryptographic operations within dedicated security hardware, according to the company. Unlike conventional MPC implementations that may perform portions of the signing process outside dedicated security hardware, Blockstream said its architecture executes the entire signing protocol within the protected environment of Thales’ HSMs. Blockstream co-founder and CEO Adam Back, a pioneering cryptographer whose Hashcash system helped lay the groundwork for Bitcoin’s proof-of-work mechanism, told Cointelegraph that conventional MPC protocols are often too complex and require too much communication between devices to be practical for fully offline cold storage. “When people talk about MPC, they’re talking about some very esoteric and complicated protocols that are hard to secure and are very interactive. So you can’t really use them in a cold storage setting,” Back said. Related: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC Adam Back makes the case for simpler Bitcoin custody Back pointed to the Binance $6.3 billion hack as an example of the risks facing internet-connected custody infrastructure, arguing that keeping signing devices offline can help prevent unauthorized access. According to Binance’s investigation, attackers compromised employee devices and obtained credentials that allowed them to access the exchange’s wallet-signing infrastructure. If you connect equipment to the internet, even if it’s via firewalls and so on, there is risk that you can get unauthorized access. You can get hackers into the network, get hackers with access to logins they shouldn’t have and so on. He also said that AI could make existing security challenges more difficult to manage, particularly by helping attackers discover subtle flaws in complex MPC implementations. “The AIs can help attackers find small implementation errors and things like that, which may not be obvious,” he said. Asked whether the broader custody industry would adopt similar offline security models, Back said he hoped so, arguing that institutions should “adapt to the environment” by moving assets into cold storage to reduce exposure to potential AI-assisted attacks. “Complexity is the enemy of security. And going back to basics is the answer, you know, just cold-store it,” Back added. Magazine: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express

articles.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), Plastikkart ve Flap Kongre’nin bedelsiz sermaye artırımlarına onay verdi. İki şirketin toplam sermayesi 116,5 milyon TL’den 700 milyon TL’ye yükselecek.
articles.articleText: SPK'dan iki şirkete bedelsiz sermaye artırımı onayı - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), Plastikkart ve Flap Kongre’nin bedelsiz sermaye artırımlarına onay verdi. - İki şirketin toplam sermayesi 116,5 milyon TL’den 700 milyon TL’ye yükselecek. SPK bülteninde yer alan karara göre Plastikkart Akıllı Kart İletişim Sistemleri'nin 22 milyon 750 bin TL olan mevcut sermayesi, 277 milyon 250 bin TL bedelsiz artırımla 300 milyon TL’ye çıkarılacak. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Flap Kongre Toplantı Hizmetleri'nin ise 93 milyon 750 bin TL olan sermayesi, 306 milyon 250 bin TL bedelsiz artırımla 400 milyon TL’ye yükselecek. Böylece iki şirketin sermaye artırımına konu toplam bedelsiz tutarı 583 milyon 500 bin TL olacak. Bedelsiz sermaye artırımı, şirketlerin iç kaynaklarını (yedek akçeler, geçmiş yıl kârları veya sermaye düzeltmesi olumlu farkları gibi) kullanarak sermayelerini artırmasıdır. Bu işlemde yatırımcılar yeni payları ücretsiz alır; hisse sayısı artarken yatırımcının şirketteki ortaklık oranı, diğer koşullar aynı kaldığı sürece değişmez. Hisse fiyatı ise sermaye artırımına bağlı olarak teorik biçimde düzeltilir.

FAA'dan ülke genelinde kalkış yasağı - ABD Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA), hava trafik kontrol iletişim sistemlerinde yaşanan ciddi sorunların ardından güvenlik gerekçesiyle ülke genelindeki tüm kalkışları durdurdu. - Havada bulunan uçakların inişine izin verilirken yerdeki uçakların yeni bir duyuruya kadar kalkış yapamayacağı bildirildi. FAA, cuma günü yaptığı açıklamada, olağanüstü koşullar ve güvenlik gerekçeleri nedeniyle ülke genelinde kalkışlara yönelik yer durdurma kararı alındığını duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Açıklama öncesinde Chicago'daki hava trafiği de iletişim sorunları nedeniyle durduruldu. Uluslararası uçuşların ise vaka bazında değerlendirileceği belirtildi. Karar, havadaki uçakların inişini engellemiyor ancak yerde bekleyen uçakların kalkış yapmasına izin vermiyor. 11 Eylül'den bu yana ikinci kez Ülke genelindeki tüm kalkışların durdurulması, 11 Eylül 2001 saldırılarından bu yana ikinci kez yaşandı. Daha önce Ocak 2023'te FAA, sistemdeki bir sorun nedeniyle ABD'deki tüm iç hat kalkışlarını iki saatten kısa süreyle durdurmuştu. FAA için 30,1 milyar dolarlık ek kaynak talebi ABD Kongresi, geçen yıl FAA'nın eskiyen iletişim sistemlerinin yenilenmesi için 12,5 milyar dolarlık bütçeyi onaylamıştı. FAA ve Beyaz Saray ise cuma günü diğer sorunların giderilmesi amacıyla Kongre'den ilave 30,1 milyar dolar talep etti. FAA, ABD'de sivil havacılığın güvenliğini ve hava trafik yönetimini düzenleyen federal kurum olarak görev yapıyor. Karar, hava trafik kontrolündeki iletişim altyapısının uçuş güvenliği açısından önemini yeniden gündeme taşıdı.

articles.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
articles.summary: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
articles.summaryTr: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.
articles.articleText: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption - Published Microsoft has said it is "deeply sorry" for the service outage to its products, including Outlook and Teams, which has caused disruption around the world. Services were broadly recovering by Friday afternoon, nearly 24 hours after issues began. Microsoft said it was making "encouraging progress", but added it does not know when services will fully recover. The outage hit more than 70 countries, disrupting everything from business operations to government services and personal users. More than 430 million people use the affected products worldwide. Microsoft said it was a technical issue introduced during a "network capacity upgrade" and not related to cyber or artificial intelligence agents. Experts said the event was a "stark reminder" of how heavily businesses and vital services rely on a small group of big tech providers. Users began reporting they were having trouble accessing Microsoft 365 products on Thursday. By Friday, the far-reaching issue was affecting institutions from the Japanese government and the Philippines Supreme Court to the Australian spy agency, and trains, hospitals and courts in North America. - Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost? - Published5 hours ago - Courts, spies and MPs: How the Microsoft outage has been felt around the world - Published6 hours ago In the UK, some parts of the NHS, including GPs and hospitals, were affected, as were some schools and police forces. UK cyber minister Liz Lloyd said the incident had "limited" impact on critical frontline services such as 999 calls, and there had been no disruption to the transport network. In Canada, however, the national rail network said passengers may not be able to receive email updates about their trips, and hospitals across the country also had issues with emails. In the US, staff members from the House of Representatives told Politico it had set back an entire day of legislative work as everything was on Microsoft's Outlook. Singapore's government acknowledged some of its systems had been impacted, and in India, the outage disrupted work for many on Friday. In Turkey, advisers and officials attending the COP31 climate summit in Antalya were left frustrated by being unable to access Outlook. The issues also affected smaller businesses and individuals. Peter Pentz, a winemaker in South Africa, said his entire business was basically brought to a "standstill". His winery's communication with exports was also brought to a standstill, he said, and "critical production work" was been halted as the Cape West Coast winery "relies on these systems for parts of our day-to-day operations". Georgia from Staffordshire in England said she was due to complete her first house purchase today after waiting eight months to get to this point - but the outage has delayed that. "The solicitor mentioned there may be a delay due to not being able to contact other agencies. "We're not the only one completing today, there are hundreds of houses and for them to ring everyone in time is unfeasible," Georgia said. 'Encouraging recovery signals' Microsoft first acknowledged users in the Americas were unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes at 17:54 GMT on Thursday, and shortly after warned the disruption was possibly affecting Microsoft 365 globally. While it launched an investigation and engineers began working to restore services, by 04:36 on Friday Microsoft was reporting only a "partial recovery" in some parts of the world. By 13:32, the tech giant said there were "broader improvements" in North America, "sustained improvements" across much of Europe and "encouraging recovery signals" in the Asia Pacific region. Microsoft said it restored services gradually due to the scale of the problem and to help ensure services remain stable once they are up and running again. "We are deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners," a Microsoft spokesperson said. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously." Microsoft said it has no "ETA" for when services will be fully recovered. A full post-incident report will be released once Microsoft has completed a review. Experts said while workers may have been happy to not have email access for the day, the incident showed the dependence many organisations have on these cloud-based services. "The global Microsoft outage is a stark reminder of how heavily we rely on a handful of big tech providers," said Rob Demain, chief executive of cybersecurity firm e2e-assure. Matt Saunders, field chief technology officer at tech consultancy Adaptavist, said it would be challenging to mitigate against a similar problem. "Classic IT disaster planning strategies suggest using a second service for resilience, but in practice, it's almost impossible for a business to function without tools such as Microsoft," he said. "In the wake of this outage, organisations must have a plan in place for how to work without such tools, for when incidents like this occur." articles.summary: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO pay piyasalarındaki işlemler nedeniyle kapsamlı yaptırım kararı aldı. Kurul, 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirirken 76 kişi hakkında da suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verdi.

articles.titleTr: SPK'dan 3 hisseye çifte yaptırım! 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete işlem yasağı
articles.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO pay piyasalarındaki işlemler nedeniyle kapsamlı yaptırım kararı aldı. Kurul, 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirirken 76 kişi hakkında da suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verdi.
articles.articleText: SPK'dan 3 hisseye çifte yaptırım! 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete işlem yasağı - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO pay piyasalarındaki işlemler nedeniyle kapsamlı yaptırım kararı aldı. - Kurul, 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirirken 76 kişi hakkında da suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verdi. SPK'nın incelemeleri sonucunda EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO hisselerinde gerçekleştirilen işlemlerin piyasa dolandırıcılığı kapsamında değerlendirildiği belirtildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kurul, söz konusu işlemlerle bağlantılı olarak hem gerçek kişiler hem de şirketler hakkında yaptırım uyguladı. 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl işlem yasağı SPK kararına göre EDATA işlemleri nedeniyle 8, KARCL işlemleri nedeniyle 44, GRTHO işlemleri nedeniyle 24 kişi hakkında işlem yasağı kararı verildi. Birden fazla dosyada adı geçen kişiler bulunduğundan, toplam 76 kayda karşılık 65 farklı kişiye 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirildi. Karar kapsamında 6 şirkete de ilgili paylarda kendi nam ve hesaplarına gerçekleştirdikleri işlemlerle sınırlı olmak üzere 2 yıl işlem yasağı uygulandı. Bu şirketler A1 Capital Portföy Yönetimi, A1 Capital Yatırım Menkul Değerler, Pardus Portföy Yönetimi, Tera Girişim Sermayesi Yatırım Ortaklığı, Tera Portföy Yönetimi ve Tera Yatırım Bankası oldu. Etkin pişmanlık için 15 gün süre Kurul, hakkında suç duyurusu kararı alınan kişilerin Kanun'un 107/3'üncü maddesi kapsamında etkin pişmanlık hükümlerinden yararlanabileceğini bildirdi. Buna göre, bu hükümlerden yararlanmak isteyenlerin, 500 bin TL'den az olmamak üzere elde ettikleri veya elde edilmesine neden oldukları menfaatin iki katı tutarındaki parayı SPK kararından itibaren 15 gün içinde Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı'nın ilgili hesabına yatırmaları gerekiyor. articles.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.summary: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.summaryTr: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.
articles.articleText: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded. Kraken’s parent company Payward nearly doubled its share of global crypto spot trading to 6.5% in September from 3.3% a year earlier, even as weaker trading activity weighed on its earnings. The market-share gain means Payward captured a larger portion of spot trading relative to competitors, rather than an increase in trading activity across its platforms. The company handled $353 billion in transactions in the third quarter, down 30% from a year earlier, according to financial results released Friday. The two figures measure different things. The market share tracks its portion of global spot trading across its platforms in September, compared with a year earlier, while Payward’s quarterly transaction volume includes activity across multiple products, including spot, margin, equities, payments and certain derivatives. Adjusted EBITDA fell to $60 million from the $178.6 million reported a year earlier. Total platform margin fell 12% to $487 million. Payward introduced that measure this quarter to replace adjusted revenue, adding a deduction for staking rewards paid to customers. Acquisitions expand Payward beyond spot trading Payward has spent the past two years expanding beyond its core cryptocurrency exchange business through acquisitions in derivatives, proprietary trading, tokenized assets and payments. The strategy aims to diversify revenue beyond transaction fees, which fluctuate with market activity. Its purchases include futures broker NinjaTrader and proprietary trading firm Breakout in 2025, followed by the acquisition of US-regulated derivatives platform Bitnomial in May 2026. The company also expanded into stablecoin payments with its purchase of Reap in July. Those businesses contributed to a broader mix of trading and service-based activity in the third quarter. The number of derivatives contracts on which Payward charges a per-contract fee rose 84% to 66 million. Margin from subscriptions, trader evaluations and other paid services rose 59% to $125 million. Breakout, which charges traders for evaluations that can qualify them for funded trading accounts, was included for the full quarter after joining in September 2025. The July purchase of Reap added a stablecoin payments and card-issuing business. The company did not quantify either acquisition’s contribution to the quarter. Related: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business Earnings recover from second-quarter lows Results improved from the second quarter despite remaining below year-earlier levels. Total transaction volume rose 22%, while total platform margin increased 12% to $487 million from $436 million. The improvement was not driven by trading alone. Margin earned from assets customers hold on Payward’s platforms, including staking-related services, rose 26% to $128 million. That accounted for roughly half of the $51 million quarterly increase in total platform margin. Adjusted EBITDA climbed to $60 million from $23 million, while its margin relative to total platform margin rose to 12% from 5%. Compared with a year earlier, however, adjusted EBITDA was down 66%, underscoring the pressure on profitability despite a growing contribution from services less directly tied to trading activity. Asset- and access-based services accounted for 52% of total platform margin, up from 46% a year earlier. That shift could matter for an eventual public listing. Payward confidentially filed for a US IPO in November 2025 but paused its plans in March as market conditions weakened. By September, the earliest potential listing window under consideration was the second quarter of 2027. Magazine: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum

articles.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.summary: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.summaryTr: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.
articles.articleText: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest. Federal regulators are opening more avenues for crypto companies to operate under US rules, while congressional investigators are asking to see the records behind those decisions. Lawmakers want to know how regulators justified new trust charters, how crypto companies handled compliance and what dealings they had with people tied to President Donald Trump’s administration. On Nov. 9, Coinbase announced that its national trust company had received final approval to open. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted preliminary conditional approval in April. The company said the charter gives its custody business a consistent federal framework. Lawmakers had been questioning how federal regulators were using their existing authority to expand crypto companies’ reach. In a May 18 letter to the OCC, Sen. Elizabeth Warren challenged at least nine crypto trust-charter approvals, including Coinbase’s earlier conditional approval. She asked for the applications, the legal analyses behind the approvals and any related communications between OCC officials and the White House or Trump family. Four days before Coinbase’s announcement, Sen. Richard Blumenthal renewed demands for records from Binance, Tether and two Trump-linked ventures. He gave them until Jan. 4, 2027, to turn over the requested records voluntarily and warned that his subcommittee could take other steps to obtain them. To read the full report sign up for the Daybreak Newsletter.

articles.articleText: Borsada 419 milyon TL'lik özel emir trafiği! THYAO ve ISCTR'de dikkat çeken hareket - BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 0,27 yükselişle 11.842,82 puandan kapandığı 13 Kasım'da 8 hisse senedinde özel emirle işlem yapıldı. - En yüksek işlem hacmi 176,9 milyon TL ile THYAO'da, en yüksek lot miktarı ise 10 milyon lotla ISCTR'de gerçekleşti. BIST 100'ün yüzde 0,27 yükseldiği 13 Kasım'da 8 hissede toplam 419,5 milyon TL'lik özel emir işlemi gerçekleştirildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İşlem hacminde THYAO, lot miktarında ise ISCTR ilk sırada yer aldı. 13 Kasım'da özel emirle işlem yapılan hisseler Özel emir işlemi nedir? Özel emir, hisse senedinde alıcı ve satıcının karşılıklı anlaşmasıyla, borsada o anda oluşan fiyatlardan bağımsız olarak belirlenen fiyat üzerinden gerçekleştirilen işlemdir. Bu emirlerde işlem yapılacak karşı yatırım kuruluşu, nominal tutar, fiyat, valör ve sermaye piyasası aracı belirtilir. Özel emir yalnızca işlemin karşı tarafı olarak belirlenen yatırım kuruluşu tarafından görüntülenebilir. Bazı yüksek tutarlı işlemlerin ardından alıcı ve satıcı taraflar pay alım satım bildirimlerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımlayabilir. Bildirim yapılmadığı durumlarda işlemin hangi yatırımcılar tarafından gerçekleştirildiğinin bilinmesi mümkün değildir.

OpenAI'dan Wallet hamlesi OpenAI, yapay zeka ajanlarının kullanıcıların gerçek kart bilgilerine erişmeden ödeme yapmasını sağlayan ChatGPT Wallet'ı tanıttı. İlk aşamada ABD'deki sınırlı sayıda ChatGPT Pro abonesine sunulacak dijital cüzdanda her satın alma işlemi kullanıcı onayından geçecek. OpenAI, American Express, Mastercard ve Visa işbirliğiyle geliştirdiği ChatGPT Wallet adlı dijital cüzdan hizmetini duyurdu. Yeni özellik, yapay zeka ajanlarının kullanıcılar adına alışveriş işlemlerini tamamlamasına imkan tanıyacak. Şirketin açıklamasına göre ChatGPT Wallet, başlangıçta ABD'deki sınırlı sayıda ChatGPT Pro abonesine Dots adlı kişisel yapay zeka ajanı hizmeti üzerinden sunulacak. Kullanıcıların gerçek kart bilgileri işletmelerle veya yapay zeka ajanlarıyla paylaşılmayacak. Her ödeme için kullanıcı onayı gerekecek ChatGPT Wallet üzerinden alışveriş yapmak isteyen kullanıcılar, ödeme kartlarını sisteme bir kez tanımlayacak. Sonraki işlemlerde kart bilgilerini yeniden girmelerine gerek kalmayacak. Ancak her satın alma öncesinde ürünler, toplam tutar ve kullanılacak kart kullanıcıya gösterilecek. Ödeme, Face ID veya parmak izi gibi güvenlik kontrollerinin ardından onaylanacak. Kullanıcının onay vermesiyle ödeme ağı, gerçek kart bilgilerinin yerine geçen bir token oluşturacak. Kart numarası, güvenlik kodu ve son kullanma tarihi içeren bu token üzerinden ödeme gerçekleştirilirken gerçek kart bilgileri işletmeyle paylaşılmayacak. Yapay zeka ajanlarına alışveriş yetkisi geliyor OpenAI, ChatGPT Wallet ile işletmelerin yapay zeka ajanları aracılığıyla alışveriş yapan müşterilere hizmet verebilmesini sağlayacak araçlar ve rehberler de yayımladı. Şirket, her hafta 1,2 milyar kişinin ChatGPT'yi kullandığını ve kullanıcıların ürün araştırma, karşılaştırma ve satın alma kararlarında yapay zekadan yararlandığını belirtti. Yeni cüzdanla birlikte kullanıcıların satın alma işlemlerini de ChatGPT üzerinden tamamlamasının önü açılacak. Gelecekte harcama yetkisi tamamen ajanlara devredilebilecek OpenAI'ın gelecek döneme ilişkin hedefleri arasında kullanıcıların harcama limitleri, satın alma kategorileri ve belirli zaman aralıkları gibi sınırlar belirleyerek alışveriş işlemlerini tamamen yapay zeka ajanlarına devredebilmesi de bulunuyor. Hizmetin ilk aşamada sınırlı sayıda kullanıcıya açılacağı, gerçek kullanım deneyimleri doğrultusunda güvenlik, uyumluluk ve güvenilirlik çalışmalarının geliştirileceği bildirildi.

articles.titleTr: Borsada şirketlerden peş peşe hamleler! Milyonluk anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar gündemde
articles.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 8 şirket, yayımladıkları KAP açıklamalarıyla yeni iş ilişkileri, stratejik anlaşmalar ve yatırımlara imza attıklarını duyurdu.
articles.articleText: Borsada şirketlerden peş peşe hamleler! Milyonluk anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar gündemde Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 8 şirket, yayımladıkları KAP açıklamalarıyla yeni iş ilişkileri, stratejik anlaşmalar ve yatırımlara imza attıklarını duyurdu. LINK, 11,5 milyon TL'lik yüz tanıma kamerası projesini tamamladı Link Bilgisayar, Emniyet Genel Müdürlüğü ile imzaladığı 11 milyon 554 bin TL bedelli KGYS yüz tanıma kamerası projesini tamamladı. Şirket, teslimat ve faturalandırma işlemlerinin gerçekleştirildiğini KAP'a bildirdi. EUPWR, TEİAŞ ihalesinde 205,9 milyon TL'lik teklifle birinci oldu Europower Enerji, TEİAŞ'ın 152 adet metal clad hücre ve yedek malzeme alımı ihalesinde en avantajlı teklifi vererek ilk sırada yer aldı. İhalenin baz bedeli 205 milyon 917 bin TL olarak açıklandı. QNBFK'den 75 milyon euroluk kredi anlaşması QNB Finansal Kiralama, uluslararası kalkınma finansmanı kuruluşu Proparco ile 75 milyon euro tutarında kredi anlaşması imzaladı. İş Leasing'den 100 milyon euro ve 30 milyon dolarlık kredi anlaşması İş Finansal Kiralama, Hollanda Kalkınma Bankası FMO liderliğindeki sendikasyon kapsamında 100 milyon euro ve 30 milyon dolar tutarında kredi sözleşmesi imzaladı. Kaynağın yeni katılımcıyla 50 milyon dolara kadar artırılması mümkün olacak. SAYAS'tan Endonezya'ya 1,3 milyon euroluk sipariş Say Yenilenebilir Enerji'nin Endonezya merkezli müşterisi PT. Kenertec Power System'e verdiği teklifler onaylandı. Toplam 1 milyon 315 bin 914 euro tutarındaki siparişin teslimatlarının 2027'nin ilk çeyreğinde tamamlanması bekleniyor. FONET, Hatay'da 216,7 milyon TL'lik ihaleyi kazandı Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri, Hatay İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü tarafından düzenlenen 36 aylık sağlık bilgi yönetim sistemi hizmet alımı ihalesinin kazananı oldu. İhalenin bedeli 216 milyon 681 bin 840 TL olarak açıklandı. TAV Havalimanları, TAV Batum'un tamamını 3 milyon dolara satın aldı TAV Havalimanları, TAV Batum'daki yüzde 24'lük payı 3 milyon dolara devraldı. Satın alma sonrası şirketin TAV Batum'daki ortaklık oranı yüzde 76'dan yüzde 100'e yükseldi. GEN İlaç'tan 5 milyar TL'lik enerji yatırımı! Seleda'nın yüzde 81,4'ünü aldı Gen İlaç, biyogaz ve güneş enerjisi alanında faaliyet gösteren Seleda Biyogaz'ın yüzde 81,4'lük payını 5 milyar 27 milyon TL bedelle devraldı. Pay devir işlemleri 13 Kasım'da tamamlandı.

articles.title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
articles.summary: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.

articles.titleTr: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
articles.summaryTr: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.
articles.articleText: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge - Published Senator Chuck Schumer is facing a challenge to his position as US Senate majority leader from his fellow Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen, as the party prepares to take control of Congress after sweeping the midterm elections. Van Hollen, 67, said in a post on X on Thursday that Americans voted for change earlier this month and "to deliver, we need new leadership". Schumer, 75, has led Democrats in the chamber since 2017, serving as both majority and minority leader. He was first elected to the Senate in 1999. Following the midterms earlier this month, his position has come under pressure by some left-wing Democrats who see him as too moderate and part of the party establishment. Responding to the challenge, Schumer, who represents New York, said he welcomed "any discussion about the future of our caucus and the important work ahead". He added that he was "proud of what we've accomplished together" in the midterms, and he had "the votes to continue as Democratic leader". The vote on Senate leader will be held behind closed doors in early December and the winner will assume the role on 4 January, when Democrats take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives after their midterms successes. The move by Van Hollen, who represents Maryland, marks the most significant step by a high-profile Democrat to challenge the party's existing leadership following last week's midterms victory. Announcing his plans to run in a post on X, he wrote that Americans had called on the party to "unrig an economy rigged against working people". "We should not be preserving our institutions if they are not delivering for the American people," he said at a summit in Colorado hosted by majority Democrats. "And we should be making delivering for the American people the single mission of our government, even when that means shaking things up." He added: "This country does not belong to the people who can afford to buy influence. It belongs to all of us. And it's time we govern like that." In recent years, Van Hollen has taken positions popular with those on the left of his party. In 2024, he supported restricting weapons shipments to Israel and criticised the Biden administration over its role in the war in Gaza. In an interview with MS NOW, Van Hollen - who has served in the Senate for nearly a decade - acknowledged that he was an "underdog" but added that he believed the race was "very much in flux". Independent Senator Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have both publicly come out in support of Van Hollen - while others have also called for new leadership. In a post on X, Sanders said he believed Van Hollen "will stand up to powerful special interests, take on the billionaire class and fight for working families". El-Sayed said the challenger would bring "bold leadership" and lead with both "courage and experience". Others Democrats have publicly backed Schumer. Senator Jacky Rosen of Nevada said: "He has the experience and the fight to continue leading our diverse caucus at this crucial moment". Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said: "You will see, despite all the grumblings, enormous gratitude for the hard work he has done to get us to this position." - Published23 hours ago - Published2 days ago - Published2 days ago

articles.titleTr: COP31’de sanat ve iklim krizi buluştu: Altı sanatçıdan ortak çağrı
articles.summaryTr: Antalya’da düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında sanat ve iklim krizi COPArt’ta buluştu. Altı sanatçının eserlerinden oluşan seçki, geri dönüştürülmüş metallerden doğanın kırılganlığına uzanan çalışmalarla insanın çevreyle ilişkisini ve gezegenin geleceğini sorguluyor.
articles.articleText: COP31’de sanat ve iklim krizi buluştu: Altı sanatçıdan ortak çağrı - Antalya’da düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında sanat ve iklim krizi COPArt’ta buluştu. Altı sanatçının eserlerinden oluşan seçki, geri dönüştürülmüş metallerden doğanın kırılganlığına uzanan çalışmalarla insanın çevreyle ilişkisini ve gezegenin geleceğini sorguluyor. RS Sanat Alanı, Birleşmiş Milletler İklim Değişikliği 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) kapsamında Antalya’da düzenlenen COPArt’ta sanatseverlerle buluşuyor. 20 Kasım’a kadar konferansın Green Zone ve Blue Zone alanlarında ziyaret edilebilen seçki; iklim acil durumunu, doğanın kırılganlığını ve insanın çevresi üzerindeki etkisini sanatın düşündüren, sorgulatan ve harekete geçiren diliyle gündeme taşıyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle RS Sanat Alanı, COPArt’taki seçkisiyle iklim acil durumuna ilişkin tartışmalara sanatın özgün bakışını da katıyor. Sanatçılara verdiği destekle farklı ifade biçimlerine alan açarken ziyaretçileri ortak bir soru etrafında buluşturuyor: Doğayla kurduğumuz ilişkiyi değiştirmek için neyi görmemiz, neyi hatırlamamız ve neyi dönüştürmemiz gerekiyor? Asaf Erdemli, Berkan Baycan, Ceylan Sakin Dökmen, Gönül Nuhoğlu, İsmet Doğan ve Murat Uçar’ın eserlerini, COP31 katılımcılarıyla buluşturan RS Sanat Alanı, farklı sanat pratiklerinin çevresel ve toplumsal meseleler etrafında diyalog kurmasına destek veriyor. Doğa, hafıza, dönüşüm ve aidiyet kavramları etrafında şekillenen çalışmalar, ziyaretçilerin insanın dünyadaki yerine ve diğer canlılarla ilişkisine yeniden bakmasını sağlıyor. Asaf Erdemli, “Bu İşte Bir Terslik Var” adlı enstalasyonunda Türkiye’nin doğal ve kültürel mirasının simgelerinden ters laleyi, geri dönüştürülmüş metaller aracılığıyla yeniden yorumluyor. COP31 kapsamında özel olarak üretilen 31 adet ters lale heykelinden oluşan enstalasyon, üretim ve tüketim alışkanlıklarımızı sorgularken, atıl malzemelerin yeniden değer kazanmasına dikkat çekiyor. Sanatçı, geri dönüşümü yalnızca bir üretim yöntemi olarak değil, doğaya ve geleceğe karşı kolektif bir sorumluluk olarak ele alıyor. Berkan Baycan’ın “Observer” adlı video çalışmasında bakışın yönü değişiyor: İnsan doğayı izlerken doğa da insanın yaptıklarına tanıklık ediyor. Ceylan Sakin Dökmen’in “Güneş Ağacı”, “Rüzgara Kapıldım” ve “Ağıt Ağaç” adlı metal heykelleri, doğanın kırılganlığı ile yenilenme gücünü aynı yüzeyde buluşturuyor. Eserlerdeki çatlaklar ve boşluklar, kırılmanın izlerini taşırken yeniden oluşun ihtimalini de barındırıyor. Sanatçı, metalin sertliği üzerinden doğanın hassas dengelerine dikkat çekiyor. Gönül Nuhoğlu’nun “Dreaming Rhino” adlı çalışmasındaki uyuyan gergedan, iklim krizi karşısındaki kolektif kayıtsızlığın simgesine dönüşüyor. Eser, büyüyen tehditlerin gündelik yaşam içinde nasıl sıradanlaştığını sorgularken izleyiciyi kendi duyarsızlıklarıyla yüzleşmeye davet ediyor. İnsan doğaya baktığında yalnızca çevresini değil, kendi kökenlerini de görüyor. İsmet Doğan, “Kök-en” ve “Autos” serisinde insanın doğayla, geçmişiyle ve kendi varoluşuyla kurduğu bağı sorguluyor. Murat Uçar’ın eserleri, Türkiye tarihinde ilklere imza atmış 36 ismin yaşamına büyüteç aracılığıyla yakından bakmaya davet ediyor. Kolektif hafızayı şekillendiren öncü figürleri yeniden görünür kılan eserler, değişimin ardındaki insan hikâyelerini seçkinin odağına taşıyor.

articles.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
articles.summary: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
articles.summaryTr: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
articles.articleText: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost? - Published A major Microsoft outage has impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world. Services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot, are being restored almost 24 hours since issues first surfaced. Microsoft said the outage was not a cyber-security incident and was caused by a technical issue. It has apologised for the disruption. Here's what we know about the services affected and what went wrong. What happened? Some Microsoft 365 services have been affected by "connectivity problems" with problems reported in at least 74 countries. From late on Thursday, customers reported varying levels of access - many were unable to send or receive emails, view certain files or details on their calendar apps. But some users were able to use Teams, messaging and online meeting functions without issues. As of Friday afternoon, Microsoft said it had seen "encouraging recovery progress" in Europe and improvement in North America. The company added that it was focused on "addressing the remaining areas of disruption" but warned "some users may still experience intermittent issues". In a later statement, the company said it was continuing to see improvements "with email queues significantly reduced and approaching normal levels". The company attributed the ongoing outage to an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade. "We have addressed the underlying issue and continue to restore service to remaining customers and regions," it said on Friday. Will emails affected by the outage ever arrive? Although services are beginning to resume, Microsoft has warned of continued "intermittent access issues", meaning some users will still struggle to load their inboxes and could experience "delayed email delivery". In other words, it is not quite safe to assume every email you send is going to arrive in its intended recipient's inbox right away. Earlier, Microsoft said it would be extending the "timeout window" to 48 hours "to help protect delayed messages as delivery catches up". The email timeout window refers to the amount of time Outlook will wait to receive an email. When they do show up, the timestamp will be when they were delivered rather than when they were sent. Why has it taken so long to fix? Although email service Outlook appears to be resuming, the outage has so far lasted for more than 20 hours - in outage terms that is considered a long time. Prof James Ferryman from the University of Reading's department of computer science said the details the company has disclosed provide some clues. "What Microsoft has told us is that the part of its servers that sets up secure connections is getting swamped, and once that happens the server just stops answering," he said. "The trouble is that this kind of failure snowballs. "One server falls over, its work gets passed to the next one, and meanwhile huge numbers of phones and laptops keep trying to get back in. "You can't just turn it all back on at once. You have to bring it back bit by bit." The challenge is therefore not just fixing the fault, but managing the huge surge of devices trying to reconnect once services start coming back online. Gergely Orosz, a former leading software engineer at several major tech companies including Skype and Uber, said this could be the "most disruptive" business email outage "of all time". He said it was still difficult to know just how many people have been affected by the disruption, but added he "cannot recall" an outage over business email ever taking this long to return to normal. Australian cyber-security expert Troy Hunt told the BBC the outage could have far-reaching consequences. "Microsoft is a massive part of the internet backbone and reminds us how critical email still is. "Not only does this outage affect many people's ability to work but also things like the ability to communicate about appointments, purchase things that need verification, create or access accounts and services," he said. In a statement, Microsoft said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously. We are seeing broad recovery and stability across our services." How many people have been affected? More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps according to Microsoft's website. The full scale of the outage has not been confirmed. Microsoft 365 is used by companies worldwide and is expected to have a knock-on effect to other services. Tech giants OpenAI and Anthropic both earlier reported problems as a result of the outage. ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it was investigating an issue affecting its connections to Microsoft's services, which had caused some tools to not work as expected. From city governments in the US to Australian spy agencies, disruption across the globe has been widespread. Courts from Los Angeles to Texas earlier warned that communications might be delayed. In Canada, the public broadcaster CBC reported that a healthcare network running several hospitals in Toronto was experiencing email issues, but that patient care was not affected. The government of Japan also said its shared IT platform had been disrupted. Across the UK, GP surgeries, pharmacies, police and schools have been affected by the outage. Some GP surgeries had urged patients not to submit messages via their website while police forces were also earlier asking the public to call if they want to make a report. Additional reporting by Henry Moore Get in touch Have you or your business been affected by the outage?
