items.articleText: Çalışma hayatında yeni dönem! 2027-2029 Adil Geçiş Planı yayımlandı - Türkiye'nin 2053 net sıfır emisyon hedefi doğrultusunda hazırlanan Ulusal Adil Geçiş Stratejisi ve Eylem Planı, Cumhurbaşkanlığı Genelgesi ile yürürlüğe girdi. - Plan kapsamında çalışanların yeni beceriler kazanması, istihdamın korunması ve dönüşümden etkilenen sektör ve bölgelerin desteklenmesi hedefleniyor. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’ın imzasını taşıyan genelge, Resmi Gazete’de yayımlandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 2027-2029 dönemini kapsayan strateji, iklim değişikliği ile yeşil ve dijital dönüşümün çalışma hayatı üzerindeki etkilerini yönetmeyi amaçlıyor. Genelgede, Türkiye’nin 2053 net sıfır emisyon hedefi doğrultusunda dönüşüm sürecinin kimseyi geride bırakmadan yürütülmesinin önemine dikkat çekildi. 2 Temmuz 2025 tarihli İklim Kanunu ile mevzuata giren adil geçiş yaklaşımının; çalışanların ve işletmelerin değişen koşullara uyum sağlamasını, yeni beceriler kazanmasını, insana yakışır işlerin artırılmasını ve sosyal korumanın güçlendirilmesini gerektirdiği belirtildi. Üç temel politika ekseni belirlendi Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı koordinasyonunda, ilgili paydaşların katılımıyla hazırlanan strateji üç temel eksene dayanıyor: Beceri uyumu: Çalışanların dönüşen iş gücü piyasasının ihtiyaçlarına uygun beceriler kazanması. Kapsayıcı dönüşüm: Yeşil ve dijital dönüşümün farklı sektör, bölge ve toplumsal gruplar üzerindeki etkilerinin gözetilmesi. Sosyal koruma ve toplumsal dayanıklılık: Dönüşüm sürecinde çalışanların ve toplumun desteklenmesi. Plan kapsamında öncelikli sektörlere yönelik sektörel politikalar da uygulanacak. Uygulama altı ayda bir raporlanacak Strateji ve Eylem Planı, Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı'nın resmi internet sitesinde yayımlanacak. Planın koordinasyon, izleme ve değerlendirme çalışmaları ilgili kamu kurumları ve sosyal tarafların katılımıyla Bakanlık tarafından yürütülecek. Eylem Planı'nda sorumlu olarak belirlenen kurum ve kuruluşlar, uygulamadaki gelişmeleri altı aylık dönemler halinde Bakanlığa bildirecek. Adil geçiş, düşük karbonlu ve çevre dostu ekonomiye geçiş sırasında çalışanların, işletmelerin ve bölgelerin olumsuz etkilenmesini önlemeyi amaçlayan politika yaklaşımıdır. Temel hedef, yeşil dönüşümün istihdam ve sosyal haklar üzerindeki maliyetlerini azaltırken yeni iş ve beceri fırsatları yaratmaktır.

items.articleText: Sözleşmeli personele yeni dönem! Disiplin cezalarından izinlere birçok kural değişti - Kamuda 4/B statüsünde görev yapan sözleşmeli personeli ilgilendiren yeni düzenleme Resmi Gazete’de yayımlandı. - Disiplin cezalarından hastalık izinlerine, göreve başlama sürelerinden kurum içi yer değişikliklerine kadar birçok konuda yeni kurallar getirildi. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın imzasıyla yayımlanan 11982 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı, 14 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yürürlüğe girdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 657 sayılı Devlet Memurları Kanunu'nun 4/B maddesi kapsamında çalışan sözleşmeli personelin çalışma koşullarını düzenleyen kararla mevcut esaslarda değişiklik yapıldı. Sözleşmeli personele disiplin cezaları uygulanacak Yeni düzenlemeyle sözleşmeli personelin disipline aykırı fiil ve davranışlarında devlet memurlarına uygulanan disiplin hükümlerinin kıyasen uygulanması kararlaştırıldı. Buna göre disiplin cezalarının belirlenmesi, yetkili merciler ve disiplin kurullarının işleyişinde memurlara ilişkin hükümler esas alınacak. Aylıktan kesme cezası ise personelin pozisyonuna bağlı ödemelerin toplamı üzerinden 1/30 ile 1/8 arasında uygulanabilecek. Kademe ilerlemesinin durdurulması ve daha ağır cezaları gerektiren fiillerde disiplin kurulu kararı alınacak. Personelin görevine, atamaya yetkili amirin onayıyla son verilebilecek. Hastalık izinleri ve rapor süreleri değişti Hastalık ve refakat izinlerinde, 657 sayılı Kanun'un 105'inci maddesindeki ilgili hükümler sözleşmeli personele de uygulanacak. SGK tarafından ödenen geçici iş göremezlik ödeneği ise personelin ücretinden düşülecek. Azami hastalık izni süresinin tamamlanmasının ardından göreve başlanmaması da sözleşmenin sona erdirilmesine ilişkin hükümler arasına eklendi. Göreve başlama sürelerine sınır getirildi Yeni kurallara göre aynı yerde göreve başlayacak personelin, tebliği izleyen iş günü içinde işe başlaması gerekecek. Başka bir yerde görevlendirilen personel ise tebliğ tarihinden itibaren 15 günü izleyen iş günü içinde görevine başlayacak. Belgeyle ispatlanabilen zorlayıcı nedenler dışında bu sürelere uyulmaması, sözleşmenin sona erdirilmesine neden olabilecek. Kurum içi yer değişikliğinde 3 yıl şartı 4/B kapsamında çalışan personelin kurum içi yer değişiklikleri de yeniden düzenlendi. Buna göre personelin işe başladığı tarihten itibaren aynı kurumda üç yıllık çalışma süresini tamamlayana kadar yapacağı yer değişikliklerinde belirlenen özel usul ve esaslar uygulanacak. Sözleşmeli personelin görevden uzaklaştırılmasında da devlet memurlarına ilişkin hükümler kıyasen geçerli olacak. Memur kadrosuna geçenlerin boş pozisyonları iptal edilecek Sözleşmeli personelin memur kadrosuna atanması halinde boşalan sözleşmeli personel pozisyonları, başka bir işleme gerek kalmaksızın iptal edilmiş sayılacak. İptal edilen pozisyonlar ilgili kamu personel bilgi sistemine bildirilecek. Eğitim ve ücret ödemelerinde yeni hükümler Düzenlemeyle sözleşmeli personelin temel eğitim, hazırlayıcı eğitim ve staj süreçlerinin görev yaptıkları kurumlar tarafından yürütülmesi kararlaştırıldı. Hizmet içi eğitimlerle personelin mesleki gelişiminin desteklenmesi de öngörüldü. Ücretlerin ay başında peşin ödenmesi uygulaması devam edecek. Ancak ay sonundan önce görevden ayrılan personelden kalan günlere ilişkin ödemeler geri alınacak. Memur kadrosuna atananlar, kendisine aylık bağlananlar ve hayatını kaybeden personel bu uygulamanın dışında tutulacak. Yeni düzenleme, 14 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yayımlanmasıyla yürürlüğe girdi.

items.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, OpenAI launched AI payments in ChatGPT, Jane Street nearly eightfold its Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings while trimming its BlackRock stake, and Trump nominated four SEC and CFTC commissioners, including a replacement for Hester Peirce. OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex OpenAI on Friday introduced a new feature allowing AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users directly within ChatGPT through existing payment networks, in collaboration with American Express, Mastercard and Visa. The wallet lets users authorize transactions using biometric verification, such as facial recognition or fingerprints. Payment networks generate tokenized card credentials for each approved purchase, keeping users’ actual card details from merchants and AI agents, the company said. The service is being rolled out to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US with eligible cards issued in the country. OpenAI said it plans to eventually support purchases within preset spending limits and other restrictions without requiring approval for each transaction. The launch comes as AI companies seek to move beyond product recommendations into executing transactions, potentially changing how consumers interact with online merchants. OpenAI said it is working with payment processors and fraud prevention firms to support AI purchases through existing checkout systems. Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT Jane Street’s share count in Fidelity’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) rose nearly eightfold in the third quarter, while its holdings in BlackRock’s fund fell 19%. The trading giant ended September with 7.01 million shares of Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC0, up from about 887,000 at the end of June. The position was worth $509 million on Sept. 30, according to its second-quarter and third-quarter filings. Jane Street’s holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) fell to 20.22 million shares from 24.88 million. A higher share price lifted the reported value of its stake to $957 million from $828 million. Jane Street was the largest reported institutional holder of BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF at the end of June after boosting its share count by 324% in Q2, according to 13F Pro. IBIT is the world’s largest spot Bitcoin ETF with $56 billion in net assets as of Thursday. The firm also added nearly 9 million shares (about $249 million) of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (ARKB), while more than doubling its holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) by 7.83 million shares (about $158 million). Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks US President Donald Trump has nominated Steven Levine to replace former Securities and Exchange Commission Commissioner Hester Peirce, one of the agency’s most prominent crypto advocates, as part of four nominations to fill vacancies at the SEC and Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The White House’s latest announcement on Thursday named two nominees each for the SEC and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, agencies whose decisions help shape US cryptocurrency regulation, among other functions. All four nominations require Senate confirmation. The nominations would replenish several commissioner roles. The SEC currently has only two of its five commissioner seats filled, while CFTC Chairman Michael Selig is the sole member of his agency’s five-seat commission. The nominations come weeks before Democrats are set to take control of the Senate in January, giving a narrow window for Republicans to confirm Trump’s picks.

OpenAI said it is working with payment processors and fraud prevention firms to support AI purchases through existing checkout systems. OpenAI joins a growing field of companies developing payment systems for AI agents. Google introduced its Agent Payments Protocol in 2025, while Visa and Mastercard have launched initiatives to support AI-initiated transactions. Crypto companies are also developing payment infrastructure for AI agents. Coinbase introduced its x402 protocol in 2025, enabling autonomous stablecoin payments for digital services, while Circle launched its Agent Stack in May, allowing agents to hold and spend USDC within predefined limits. Crossmint, which provides stablecoin infrastructure, has taken a different approach, combining stablecoin wallets with traditional card networks. Global agentic commerce transaction value is expected to reach $1.5 trillion by 2030, according to an April report from Juniper Research, up from an estimated $8 billion in 2026. items.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
items.summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
items.summaryTr: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
items.articleText: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks. Adam Back’s Bitcoin infrastructure company Blockstream has launched a new institutional digital asset custody solution developed with French technology group Thales, as the cryptographer pushes for simpler, offline security systems to protect Bitcoin against increasingly sophisticated cyberattacks. The solution, announced Friday, combines Thales’ hardware security modules (HSMs) with Blockstream’s Secure Multi-Party Computation (Secure-MPC) technology, allowing institutions to authorize transactions while keeping sensitive cryptographic operations within dedicated security hardware, according to the company. Unlike conventional MPC implementations that may perform portions of the signing process outside dedicated security hardware, Blockstream said its architecture executes the entire signing protocol within the protected environment of Thales’ HSMs. Blockstream co-founder and CEO Adam Back, a pioneering cryptographer whose Hashcash system helped lay the groundwork for Bitcoin’s proof-of-work mechanism, told Cointelegraph that conventional MPC protocols are often too complex and require too much communication between devices to be practical for fully offline cold storage. “When people talk about MPC, they’re talking about some very esoteric and complicated protocols that are hard to secure and are very interactive. So you can’t really use them in a cold storage setting,” Back said. Related: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC Adam Back makes the case for simpler Bitcoin custody Back pointed to the Binance $6.3 billion hack as an example of the risks facing internet-connected custody infrastructure, arguing that keeping signing devices offline can help prevent unauthorized access. According to Binance’s investigation, attackers compromised employee devices and obtained credentials that allowed them to access the exchange’s wallet-signing infrastructure. If you connect equipment to the internet, even if it’s via firewalls and so on, there is risk that you can get unauthorized access. You can get hackers into the network, get hackers with access to logins they shouldn’t have and so on. He also said that AI could make existing security challenges more difficult to manage, particularly by helping attackers discover subtle flaws in complex MPC implementations. “The AIs can help attackers find small implementation errors and things like that, which may not be obvious,” he said. Asked whether the broader custody industry would adopt similar offline security models, Back said he hoped so, arguing that institutions should “adapt to the environment” by moving assets into cold storage to reduce exposure to potential AI-assisted attacks. “Complexity is the enemy of security. And going back to basics is the answer, you know, just cold-store it,” Back added. Magazine: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express

items.summary: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), Plastikkart ve Flap Kongre’nin bedelsiz sermaye artırımlarına onay verdi. İki şirketin toplam sermayesi 116,5 milyon TL’den 700 milyon TL’ye yükselecek.

items.articleText: SPK'dan iki şirkete bedelsiz sermaye artırımı onayı - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), Plastikkart ve Flap Kongre’nin bedelsiz sermaye artırımlarına onay verdi. - İki şirketin toplam sermayesi 116,5 milyon TL’den 700 milyon TL’ye yükselecek. SPK bülteninde yer alan karara göre Plastikkart Akıllı Kart İletişim Sistemleri'nin 22 milyon 750 bin TL olan mevcut sermayesi, 277 milyon 250 bin TL bedelsiz artırımla 300 milyon TL’ye çıkarılacak. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Flap Kongre Toplantı Hizmetleri'nin ise 93 milyon 750 bin TL olan sermayesi, 306 milyon 250 bin TL bedelsiz artırımla 400 milyon TL’ye yükselecek. Böylece iki şirketin sermaye artırımına konu toplam bedelsiz tutarı 583 milyon 500 bin TL olacak. Bedelsiz sermaye artırımı, şirketlerin iç kaynaklarını (yedek akçeler, geçmiş yıl kârları veya sermaye düzeltmesi olumlu farkları gibi) kullanarak sermayelerini artırmasıdır. Bu işlemde yatırımcılar yeni payları ücretsiz alır; hisse sayısı artarken yatırımcının şirketteki ortaklık oranı, diğer koşullar aynı kaldığı sürece değişmez. Hisse fiyatı ise sermaye artırımına bağlı olarak teorik biçimde düzeltilir.

items.title: ABD'de tüm uçuşlar durduruldu! FAA'dan ülke genelinde kalkış yasağı
items.summary: ABD Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA), hava trafik kontrol iletişim sistemlerinde yaşanan ciddi sorunların ardından güvenlik gerekçesiyle ülke genelindeki tüm kalkışları durdurdu. Havada bulunan uçakların inişine izin verilirken yerdeki uçakların yeni bir duyuruya kadar kalkış yapamayacağı bildirildi.

Havada bulunan uçakların inişine izin verilirken yerdeki uçakların yeni bir duyuruya kadar kalkış yapamayacağı bildirildi.
items.articleText: ABD'de tüm uçuşlar durduruldu! FAA'dan ülke genelinde kalkış yasağı - ABD Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA), hava trafik kontrol iletişim sistemlerinde yaşanan ciddi sorunların ardından güvenlik gerekçesiyle ülke genelindeki tüm kalkışları durdurdu. - Havada bulunan uçakların inişine izin verilirken yerdeki uçakların yeni bir duyuruya kadar kalkış yapamayacağı bildirildi. FAA, cuma günü yaptığı açıklamada, olağanüstü koşullar ve güvenlik gerekçeleri nedeniyle ülke genelinde kalkışlara yönelik yer durdurma kararı alındığını duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Açıklama öncesinde Chicago'daki hava trafiği de iletişim sorunları nedeniyle durduruldu. Uluslararası uçuşların ise vaka bazında değerlendirileceği belirtildi. Karar, havadaki uçakların inişini engellemiyor ancak yerde bekleyen uçakların kalkış yapmasına izin vermiyor. 11 Eylül'den bu yana ikinci kez Ülke genelindeki tüm kalkışların durdurulması, 11 Eylül 2001 saldırılarından bu yana ikinci kez yaşandı. Daha önce Ocak 2023'te FAA, sistemdeki bir sorun nedeniyle ABD'deki tüm iç hat kalkışlarını iki saatten kısa süreyle durdurmuştu. FAA için 30,1 milyar dolarlık ek kaynak talebi ABD Kongresi, geçen yıl FAA'nın eskiyen iletişim sistemlerinin yenilenmesi için 12,5 milyar dolarlık bütçeyi onaylamıştı. FAA ve Beyaz Saray ise cuma günü diğer sorunların giderilmesi amacıyla Kongre'den ilave 30,1 milyar dolar talep etti. FAA, ABD'de sivil havacılığın güvenliğini ve hava trafik yönetimini düzenleyen federal kurum olarak görev yapıyor. Karar, hava trafik kontrolündeki iletişim altyapısının uçuş güvenliği açısından önemini yeniden gündeme taşıdı.

items.title: SPK'dan tasfiye edilen fonların iadesine ilişkin yeni karar: Şirketlere açıklama zorunluluğu
items.summary: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), tasfiye edilen yatırım fonlarına ilişkin yeni bir karar aldı. Kurul, halka açık şirketlerin isteğe bağlı iade mekanizması kapsamında yapacağı ödemelere ilişkin kamuya açıklama, genel kurul ve finansal raporlama esaslarını duyurdu.

items.titleTr: SPK'dan tasfiye edilen fonların iadesine ilişkin yeni karar: Şirketlere açıklama zorunluluğu
items.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), tasfiye edilen yatırım fonlarına ilişkin yeni bir karar aldı. Kurul, halka açık şirketlerin isteğe bağlı iade mekanizması kapsamında yapacağı ödemelere ilişkin kamuya açıklama, genel kurul ve finansal raporlama esaslarını duyurdu.
items.articleText: SPK'dan tasfiye edilen fonların iadesine ilişkin yeni karar: Şirketlere açıklama zorunluluğu YAYIN TARİHİ, 14 Kasım 2026 00:17 GÜNCELLEME, 14 Kasım 2026 01:18 PAYLAŞ - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), tasfiye edilen yatırım fonlarına ilişkin yeni bir karar aldı. - Kurul, halka açık şirketlerin isteğe bağlı iade mekanizması kapsamında yapacağı ödemelere ilişkin kamuya açıklama, genel kurul ve finansal raporlama esaslarını duyurdu. SPK, tasfiye edilen yatırım fonlarından elde edilen kazançların halka açık şirketler tarafından isteğe bağlı olarak iade edilmesine ilişkin esasları belirledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İadelerin hisse fiyatını veya yatırımcı kararlarını etkileyebilecek nitelikte olması halinde özel durum açıklaması yapılacak. Kurulun duyurduğu ilkelere göre şirketler, söz konusu iade ödemelerini genel kurul toplantılarında ayrı bir gündem maddesiyle pay sahiplerinin bilgisine sunacak. Ödemelerin finansal tablolara nasıl yansıtılacağı ve dipnotlarda nasıl açıklanacağı ise Türkiye Muhasebe ve Finansal Raporlama Standartları çerçevesinde değerlendirilecek.

items.articleText: Watch: Cruise ship seen sinking after collision with cargo ship in New Orleans A cargo ship has collided with a docked cruise ship in New Orleans, Louisiana, with reports suggesting more than 120 people were on board the cruise ship. Eyewitness video shows the moment the cruise ship is seen sinking and the aftermath of the collision as rescue efforts are under way. New Orleans mayor Helena Moreno has said all passengers have been accounted for.

items.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
items.summary: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
items.summaryTr: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.
items.articleText: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption - Published Microsoft has said it is "deeply sorry" for the service outage to its products, including Outlook and Teams, which has caused disruption around the world. Services were broadly recovering by Friday afternoon, nearly 24 hours after issues began. Microsoft said it was making "encouraging progress", but added it does not know when services will fully recover. The outage hit more than 70 countries, disrupting everything from business operations to government services and personal users. More than 430 million people use the affected products worldwide. Microsoft said it was a technical issue introduced during a "network capacity upgrade" and not related to cyber or artificial intelligence agents. Experts said the event was a "stark reminder" of how heavily businesses and vital services rely on a small group of big tech providers. Users began reporting they were having trouble accessing Microsoft 365 products on Thursday. By Friday, the far-reaching issue was affecting institutions from the Japanese government and the Philippines Supreme Court to the Australian spy agency, and trains, hospitals and courts in North America. - Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost? - Published5 hours ago - Courts, spies and MPs: How the Microsoft outage has been felt around the world - Published6 hours ago In the UK, some parts of the NHS, including GPs and hospitals, were affected, as were some schools and police forces. UK cyber minister Liz Lloyd said the incident had "limited" impact on critical frontline services such as 999 calls, and there had been no disruption to the transport network. In Canada, however, the national rail network said passengers may not be able to receive email updates about their trips, and hospitals across the country also had issues with emails. In the US, staff members from the House of Representatives told Politico it had set back an entire day of legislative work as everything was on Microsoft's Outlook. Singapore's government acknowledged some of its systems had been impacted, and in India, the outage disrupted work for many on Friday. In Turkey, advisers and officials attending the COP31 climate summit in Antalya were left frustrated by being unable to access Outlook. The issues also affected smaller businesses and individuals. Peter Pentz, a winemaker in South Africa, said his entire business was basically brought to a "standstill". His winery's communication with exports was also brought to a standstill, he said, and "critical production work" was been halted as the Cape West Coast winery "relies on these systems for parts of our day-to-day operations". Georgia from Staffordshire in England said she was due to complete her first house purchase today after waiting eight months to get to this point - but the outage has delayed that. "The solicitor mentioned there may be a delay due to not being able to contact other agencies. "We're not the only one completing today, there are hundreds of houses and for them to ring everyone in time is unfeasible," Georgia said. 'Encouraging recovery signals' Microsoft first acknowledged users in the Americas were unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes at 17:54 GMT on Thursday, and shortly after warned the disruption was possibly affecting Microsoft 365 globally. While it launched an investigation and engineers began working to restore services, by 04:36 on Friday Microsoft was reporting only a "partial recovery" in some parts of the world. By 13:32, the tech giant said there were "broader improvements" in North America, "sustained improvements" across much of Europe and "encouraging recovery signals" in the Asia Pacific region. Microsoft said it restored services gradually due to the scale of the problem and to help ensure services remain stable once they are up and running again. "We are deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners," a Microsoft spokesperson said. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously." Microsoft said it has no "ETA" for when services will be fully recovered. A full post-incident report will be released once Microsoft has completed a review. Experts said while workers may have been happy to not have email access for the day, the incident showed the dependence many organisations have on these cloud-based services. "The global Microsoft outage is a stark reminder of how heavily we rely on a handful of big tech providers," said Rob Demain, chief executive of cybersecurity firm e2e-assure. Matt Saunders, field chief technology officer at tech consultancy Adaptavist, said it would be challenging to mitigate against a similar problem. "Classic IT disaster planning strategies suggest using a second service for resilience, but in practice, it's almost impossible for a business to function without tools such as Microsoft," he said. "In the wake of this outage, organisations must have a plan in place for how to work without such tools, for when incidents like this occur." items.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), kredili sermaye piyasası işlemlerinde özkaynak oranının esnetilerek uygulanmasına yönelik tedbirin 31 Aralık 2026 seans sonuna kadar devam etmesine karar verdi.
items.articleText: SPK'dan borsada kredili işlem kararı: Süre yıl sonuna kadar uzatıldı YAYIN TARİHİ, 14 Kasım 2026 00:13 GÜNCELLEME, 14 Kasım 2026 00:59 PAYLAŞ - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), kredili sermaye piyasası işlemlerinde özkaynak oranının esnetilerek uygulanmasına yönelik tedbirin 31 Aralık 2026 seans sonuna kadar devam etmesine karar verdi. SPK, 27 Ekim 2026 tarihli kararıyla devreye aldığı ve 30 Ekim tarihli bülteninde duyurduğu uygulamanın süresini uzattı. items.articleText: SPK'dan 3 hisseye çifte yaptırım! 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete işlem yasağı - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO pay piyasalarındaki işlemler nedeniyle kapsamlı yaptırım kararı aldı. - Kurul, 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirirken 76 kişi hakkında da suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verdi. SPK'nın incelemeleri sonucunda EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO hisselerinde gerçekleştirilen işlemlerin piyasa dolandırıcılığı kapsamında değerlendirildiği belirtildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kurul, söz konusu işlemlerle bağlantılı olarak hem gerçek kişiler hem de şirketler hakkında yaptırım uyguladı. 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl işlem yasağı SPK kararına göre EDATA işlemleri nedeniyle 8, KARCL işlemleri nedeniyle 44, GRTHO işlemleri nedeniyle 24 kişi hakkında işlem yasağı kararı verildi. Birden fazla dosyada adı geçen kişiler bulunduğundan, toplam 76 kayda karşılık 65 farklı kişiye 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirildi. Karar kapsamında 6 şirkete de ilgili paylarda kendi nam ve hesaplarına gerçekleştirdikleri işlemlerle sınırlı olmak üzere 2 yıl işlem yasağı uygulandı. Bu şirketler A1 Capital Portföy Yönetimi, A1 Capital Yatırım Menkul Değerler, Pardus Portföy Yönetimi, Tera Girişim Sermayesi Yatırım Ortaklığı, Tera Portföy Yönetimi ve Tera Yatırım Bankası oldu. Etkin pişmanlık için 15 gün süre Kurul, hakkında suç duyurusu kararı alınan kişilerin Kanun'un 107/3'üncü maddesi kapsamında etkin pişmanlık hükümlerinden yararlanabileceğini bildirdi. Buna göre, bu hükümlerden yararlanmak isteyenlerin, 500 bin TL'den az olmamak üzere elde ettikleri veya elde edilmesine neden oldukları menfaatin iki katı tutarındaki parayı SPK kararından itibaren 15 gün içinde Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı'nın ilgili hesabına yatırmaları gerekiyor. Ödeme belgelerinin de aynı süre içinde SPK'ya iletilmesi şartı bulunuyor.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
items.summary: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
items.summaryTr: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.
items.articleText: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded. Kraken’s parent company Payward nearly doubled its share of global crypto spot trading to 6.5% in September from 3.3% a year earlier, even as weaker trading activity weighed on its earnings. The market-share gain means Payward captured a larger portion of spot trading relative to competitors, rather than an increase in trading activity across its platforms. The company handled $353 billion in transactions in the third quarter, down 30% from a year earlier, according to financial results released Friday. The two figures measure different things. The market share tracks its portion of global spot trading across its platforms in September, compared with a year earlier, while Payward’s quarterly transaction volume includes activity across multiple products, including spot, margin, equities, payments and certain derivatives. Adjusted EBITDA fell to $60 million from the $178.6 million reported a year earlier. Total platform margin fell 12% to $487 million. Payward introduced that measure this quarter to replace adjusted revenue, adding a deduction for staking rewards paid to customers. Acquisitions expand Payward beyond spot trading Payward has spent the past two years expanding beyond its core cryptocurrency exchange business through acquisitions in derivatives, proprietary trading, tokenized assets and payments. The strategy aims to diversify revenue beyond transaction fees, which fluctuate with market activity. Its purchases include futures broker NinjaTrader and proprietary trading firm Breakout in 2025, followed by the acquisition of US-regulated derivatives platform Bitnomial in May 2026. The company also expanded into stablecoin payments with its purchase of Reap in July. Those businesses contributed to a broader mix of trading and service-based activity in the third quarter. The number of derivatives contracts on which Payward charges a per-contract fee rose 84% to 66 million. Margin from subscriptions, trader evaluations and other paid services rose 59% to $125 million. Breakout, which charges traders for evaluations that can qualify them for funded trading accounts, was included for the full quarter after joining in September 2025. The July purchase of Reap added a stablecoin payments and card-issuing business. The company did not quantify either acquisition’s contribution to the quarter. Related: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business Earnings recover from second-quarter lows Results improved from the second quarter despite remaining below year-earlier levels. Total transaction volume rose 22%, while total platform margin increased 12% to $487 million from $436 million. The improvement was not driven by trading alone. Margin earned from assets customers hold on Payward’s platforms, including staking-related services, rose 26% to $128 million. That accounted for roughly half of the $51 million quarterly increase in total platform margin. Adjusted EBITDA climbed to $60 million from $23 million, while its margin relative to total platform margin rose to 12% from 5%. Compared with a year earlier, however, adjusted EBITDA was down 66%, underscoring the pressure on profitability despite a growing contribution from services less directly tied to trading activity. Asset- and access-based services accounted for 52% of total platform margin, up from 46% a year earlier. That shift could matter for an eventual public listing. Payward confidentially filed for a US IPO in November 2025 but paused its plans in March as market conditions weakened. By September, the earliest potential listing window under consideration was the second quarter of 2027. Magazine: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum

items.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
items.summary: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
items.summaryTr: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.
items.articleText: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest. Federal regulators are opening more avenues for crypto companies to operate under US rules, while congressional investigators are asking to see the records behind those decisions. Lawmakers want to know how regulators justified new trust charters, how crypto companies handled compliance and what dealings they had with people tied to President Donald Trump’s administration. On Nov. 9, Coinbase announced that its national trust company had received final approval to open. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted preliminary conditional approval in April. The company said the charter gives its custody business a consistent federal framework. Lawmakers had been questioning how federal regulators were using their existing authority to expand crypto companies’ reach. In a May 18 letter to the OCC, Sen. Elizabeth Warren challenged at least nine crypto trust-charter approvals, including Coinbase’s earlier conditional approval. She asked for the applications, the legal analyses behind the approvals and any related communications between OCC officials and the White House or Trump family. Four days before Coinbase’s announcement, Sen. Richard Blumenthal renewed demands for records from Binance, Tether and two Trump-linked ventures. He gave them until Jan. 4, 2027, to turn over the requested records voluntarily and warned that his subcommittee could take other steps to obtain them. To read the full report sign up for the Daybreak Newsletter.

items.summaryTr: BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 0,27 yükselişle 11.842,82 puandan kapandığı 13 Kasım'da 8 hisse senedinde özel emirle işlem yapıldı. En yüksek işlem hacmi 176,9 milyon TL ile THYAO'da, en yüksek lot miktarı ise 10 milyon lotla ISCTR'de gerçekleşti.
items.articleText: Borsada 419 milyon TL'lik özel emir trafiği! THYAO ve ISCTR'de dikkat çeken hareket - BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 0,27 yükselişle 11.842,82 puandan kapandığı 13 Kasım'da 8 hisse senedinde özel emirle işlem yapıldı. - En yüksek işlem hacmi 176,9 milyon TL ile THYAO'da, en yüksek lot miktarı ise 10 milyon lotla ISCTR'de gerçekleşti. BIST 100'ün yüzde 0,27 yükseldiği 13 Kasım'da 8 hissede toplam 419,5 milyon TL'lik özel emir işlemi gerçekleştirildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İşlem hacminde THYAO, lot miktarında ise ISCTR ilk sırada yer aldı. 13 Kasım'da özel emirle işlem yapılan hisseler Özel emir işlemi nedir? Özel emir, hisse senedinde alıcı ve satıcının karşılıklı anlaşmasıyla, borsada o anda oluşan fiyatlardan bağımsız olarak belirlenen fiyat üzerinden gerçekleştirilen işlemdir. Bu emirlerde işlem yapılacak karşı yatırım kuruluşu, nominal tutar, fiyat, valör ve sermaye piyasası aracı belirtilir. Özel emir yalnızca işlemin karşı tarafı olarak belirlenen yatırım kuruluşu tarafından görüntülenebilir. Bazı yüksek tutarlı işlemlerin ardından alıcı ve satıcı taraflar pay alım satım bildirimlerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımlayabilir. Bildirim yapılmadığı durumlarda işlemin hangi yatırımcılar tarafından gerçekleştirildiğinin bilinmesi mümkün değildir.

items.articleText: Borsada şirketlerden güçlü geri alım trafiği! 15 milyon lotluk hamle dikkat çekti Borsa İstanbul'da 13 Kasım'da 25 şirket pay geri alımı gerçekleştirdi. Günün en yüksek alımı 15 milyon lotla Tukaş'tan gelirken, şirketlerin toplam geri alımı 20,69 milyon lotu aştı. Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerin pay geri alım programları kapsamında gerçekleştirdiği alımlar devam etti. Cuma günü 25 şirket kendi hisselerinde alım yaptı. Günün en yüksek geri alımı 15 milyon lotla Tukaş Gıda'dan (TUKAS) geldi. Tukaş'ı 2 milyon 16 bin 407 lotla İzdemir Enerji (IZENR), 884 bin 92 lotla Global Yatırım Holding (GLYHO) ve 850 bin lotla Europen Endüstri (EUREN) izledi. items.articleText: ChatGPT artık ödeme de yapacak! OpenAI'dan Wallet hamlesi OpenAI, yapay zeka ajanlarının kullanıcıların gerçek kart bilgilerine erişmeden ödeme yapmasını sağlayan ChatGPT Wallet'ı tanıttı. İlk aşamada ABD'deki sınırlı sayıda ChatGPT Pro abonesine sunulacak dijital cüzdanda her satın alma işlemi kullanıcı onayından geçecek. OpenAI, American Express, Mastercard ve Visa işbirliğiyle geliştirdiği ChatGPT Wallet adlı dijital cüzdan hizmetini duyurdu. Yeni özellik, yapay zeka ajanlarının kullanıcılar adına alışveriş işlemlerini tamamlamasına imkan tanıyacak. Şirketin açıklamasına göre ChatGPT Wallet, başlangıçta ABD'deki sınırlı sayıda ChatGPT Pro abonesine Dots adlı kişisel yapay zeka ajanı hizmeti üzerinden sunulacak. Kullanıcıların gerçek kart bilgileri işletmelerle veya yapay zeka ajanlarıyla paylaşılmayacak. Her ödeme için kullanıcı onayı gerekecek ChatGPT Wallet üzerinden alışveriş yapmak isteyen kullanıcılar, ödeme kartlarını sisteme bir kez tanımlayacak. Sonraki işlemlerde kart bilgilerini yeniden girmelerine gerek kalmayacak. Ancak her satın alma öncesinde ürünler, toplam tutar ve kullanılacak kart kullanıcıya gösterilecek. Ödeme, Face ID veya parmak izi gibi güvenlik kontrollerinin ardından onaylanacak. Kullanıcının onay vermesiyle ödeme ağı, gerçek kart bilgilerinin yerine geçen bir token oluşturacak. Kart numarası, güvenlik kodu ve son kullanma tarihi içeren bu token üzerinden ödeme gerçekleştirilirken gerçek kart bilgileri işletmeyle paylaşılmayacak. Yapay zeka ajanlarına alışveriş yetkisi geliyor OpenAI, ChatGPT Wallet ile işletmelerin yapay zeka ajanları aracılığıyla alışveriş yapan müşterilere hizmet verebilmesini sağlayacak araçlar ve rehberler de yayımladı. Şirket, her hafta 1,2 milyar kişinin ChatGPT'yi kullandığını ve kullanıcıların ürün araştırma, karşılaştırma ve satın alma kararlarında yapay zekadan yararlandığını belirtti. Yeni cüzdanla birlikte kullanıcıların satın alma işlemlerini de ChatGPT üzerinden tamamlamasının önü açılacak. Gelecekte harcama yetkisi tamamen ajanlara devredilebilecek OpenAI'ın gelecek döneme ilişkin hedefleri arasında kullanıcıların harcama limitleri, satın alma kategorileri ve belirli zaman aralıkları gibi sınırlar belirleyerek alışveriş işlemlerini tamamen yapay zeka ajanlarına devredebilmesi de bulunuyor. Hizmetin ilk aşamada sınırlı sayıda kullanıcıya açılacağı, gerçek kullanım deneyimleri doğrultusunda güvenlik, uyumluluk ve güvenilirlik çalışmalarının geliştirileceği bildirildi.

items.articleText: Borsada şirketlerden peş peşe hamleler! Milyonluk anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar gündemde Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 8 şirket, yayımladıkları KAP açıklamalarıyla yeni iş ilişkileri, stratejik anlaşmalar ve yatırımlara imza attıklarını duyurdu. LINK, 11,5 milyon TL'lik yüz tanıma kamerası projesini tamamladı Link Bilgisayar, Emniyet Genel Müdürlüğü ile imzaladığı 11 milyon 554 bin TL bedelli KGYS yüz tanıma kamerası projesini tamamladı. Şirket, teslimat ve faturalandırma işlemlerinin gerçekleştirildiğini KAP'a bildirdi. EUPWR, TEİAŞ ihalesinde 205,9 milyon TL'lik teklifle birinci oldu Europower Enerji, TEİAŞ'ın 152 adet metal clad hücre ve yedek malzeme alımı ihalesinde en avantajlı teklifi vererek ilk sırada yer aldı. İhalenin baz bedeli 205 milyon 917 bin TL olarak açıklandı. QNBFK'den 75 milyon euroluk kredi anlaşması QNB Finansal Kiralama, uluslararası kalkınma finansmanı kuruluşu Proparco ile 75 milyon euro tutarında kredi anlaşması imzaladı. İş Leasing'den 100 milyon euro ve 30 milyon dolarlık kredi anlaşması İş Finansal Kiralama, Hollanda Kalkınma Bankası FMO liderliğindeki sendikasyon kapsamında 100 milyon euro ve 30 milyon dolar tutarında kredi sözleşmesi imzaladı. Kaynağın yeni katılımcıyla 50 milyon dolara kadar artırılması mümkün olacak. SAYAS'tan Endonezya'ya 1,3 milyon euroluk sipariş Say Yenilenebilir Enerji'nin Endonezya merkezli müşterisi PT. Kenertec Power System'e verdiği teklifler onaylandı. Toplam 1 milyon 315 bin 914 euro tutarındaki siparişin teslimatlarının 2027'nin ilk çeyreğinde tamamlanması bekleniyor. FONET, Hatay'da 216,7 milyon TL'lik ihaleyi kazandı Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri, Hatay İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü tarafından düzenlenen 36 aylık sağlık bilgi yönetim sistemi hizmet alımı ihalesinin kazananı oldu. İhalenin bedeli 216 milyon 681 bin 840 TL olarak açıklandı. TAV Havalimanları, TAV Batum'un tamamını 3 milyon dolara satın aldı TAV Havalimanları, TAV Batum'daki yüzde 24'lük payı 3 milyon dolara devraldı. Satın alma sonrası şirketin TAV Batum'daki ortaklık oranı yüzde 76'dan yüzde 100'e yükseldi. GEN İlaç'tan 5 milyar TL'lik enerji yatırımı! Seleda'nın yüzde 81,4'ünü aldı Gen İlaç, biyogaz ve güneş enerjisi alanında faaliyet gösteren Seleda Biyogaz'ın yüzde 81,4'lük payını 5 milyar 27 milyon TL bedelle devraldı. Pay devir işlemleri 13 Kasım'da tamamlandı.

items.title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
items.summary: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.

items.titleTr: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
items.summaryTr: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.
items.articleText: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge - Published Senator Chuck Schumer is facing a challenge to his position as US Senate majority leader from his fellow Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen, as the party prepares to take control of Congress after sweeping the midterm elections. Van Hollen, 67, said in a post on X on Thursday that Americans voted for change earlier this month and "to deliver, we need new leadership". Schumer, 75, has led Democrats in the chamber since 2017, serving as both majority and minority leader. He was first elected to the Senate in 1999. Following the midterms earlier this month, his position has come under pressure by some left-wing Democrats who see him as too moderate and part of the party establishment. Responding to the challenge, Schumer, who represents New York, said he welcomed "any discussion about the future of our caucus and the important work ahead". He added that he was "proud of what we've accomplished together" in the midterms, and he had "the votes to continue as Democratic leader". The vote on Senate leader will be held behind closed doors in early December and the winner will assume the role on 4 January, when Democrats take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives after their midterms successes. The move by Van Hollen, who represents Maryland, marks the most significant step by a high-profile Democrat to challenge the party's existing leadership following last week's midterms victory. Announcing his plans to run in a post on X, he wrote that Americans had called on the party to "unrig an economy rigged against working people". "We should not be preserving our institutions if they are not delivering for the American people," he said at a summit in Colorado hosted by majority Democrats. "And we should be making delivering for the American people the single mission of our government, even when that means shaking things up." He added: "This country does not belong to the people who can afford to buy influence. It belongs to all of us. And it's time we govern like that." In recent years, Van Hollen has taken positions popular with those on the left of his party. In 2024, he supported restricting weapons shipments to Israel and criticised the Biden administration over its role in the war in Gaza. In an interview with MS NOW, Van Hollen - who has served in the Senate for nearly a decade - acknowledged that he was an "underdog" but added that he believed the race was "very much in flux". Independent Senator Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have both publicly come out in support of Van Hollen - while others have also called for new leadership. In a post on X, Sanders said he believed Van Hollen "will stand up to powerful special interests, take on the billionaire class and fight for working families". El-Sayed said the challenger would bring "bold leadership" and lead with both "courage and experience". Others Democrats have publicly backed Schumer. Senator Jacky Rosen of Nevada said: "He has the experience and the fight to continue leading our diverse caucus at this crucial moment". Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said: "You will see, despite all the grumblings, enormous gratitude for the hard work he has done to get us to this position." - Published23 hours ago - Published2 days ago - Published2 days ago

In 2024, he supported restricting weapons shipments to Israel and criticised the Biden administration over its role in the war in Gaza. In an interview with MS NOW, Van Hollen - who has served in the Senate for nearly a decade - acknowledged that he was an "underdog" but added that he believed the race was "very much in flux". Independent Senator Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have both publicly come out in support of Van Hollen - while others have also called for new leadership. In a post on X, Sanders said he believed Van Hollen "will stand up to powerful special interests, take on the billionaire class and fight for working families". El-Sayed said the challenger would bring "bold leadership" and lead with both "courage and experience". Others Democrats have publicly backed Schumer. Senator Jacky Rosen of Nevada said: "He has the experience and the fight to continue leading our diverse caucus at this crucial moment". Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said: "You will see, despite all the grumblings, enormous gratitude for the hard work he has done to get us to this position." - Published23 hours ago - Published2 days ago - Published2 days ago

items.summaryTr: Antalya’da düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında sanat ve iklim krizi COPArt’ta buluştu. Altı sanatçının eserlerinden oluşan seçki, geri dönüştürülmüş metallerden doğanın kırılganlığına uzanan çalışmalarla insanın çevreyle ilişkisini ve gezegenin geleceğini sorguluyor.
items.articleText: COP31’de sanat ve iklim krizi buluştu: Altı sanatçıdan ortak çağrı - Antalya’da düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında sanat ve iklim krizi COPArt’ta buluştu. Altı sanatçının eserlerinden oluşan seçki, geri dönüştürülmüş metallerden doğanın kırılganlığına uzanan çalışmalarla insanın çevreyle ilişkisini ve gezegenin geleceğini sorguluyor. RS Sanat Alanı, Birleşmiş Milletler İklim Değişikliği 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) kapsamında Antalya’da düzenlenen COPArt’ta sanatseverlerle buluşuyor. 20 Kasım’a kadar konferansın Green Zone ve Blue Zone alanlarında ziyaret edilebilen seçki; iklim acil durumunu, doğanın kırılganlığını ve insanın çevresi üzerindeki etkisini sanatın düşündüren, sorgulatan ve harekete geçiren diliyle gündeme taşıyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle RS Sanat Alanı, COPArt’taki seçkisiyle iklim acil durumuna ilişkin tartışmalara sanatın özgün bakışını da katıyor. Sanatçılara verdiği destekle farklı ifade biçimlerine alan açarken ziyaretçileri ortak bir soru etrafında buluşturuyor: Doğayla kurduğumuz ilişkiyi değiştirmek için neyi görmemiz, neyi hatırlamamız ve neyi dönüştürmemiz gerekiyor? Asaf Erdemli, Berkan Baycan, Ceylan Sakin Dökmen, Gönül Nuhoğlu, İsmet Doğan ve Murat Uçar’ın eserlerini, COP31 katılımcılarıyla buluşturan RS Sanat Alanı, farklı sanat pratiklerinin çevresel ve toplumsal meseleler etrafında diyalog kurmasına destek veriyor. Doğa, hafıza, dönüşüm ve aidiyet kavramları etrafında şekillenen çalışmalar, ziyaretçilerin insanın dünyadaki yerine ve diğer canlılarla ilişkisine yeniden bakmasını sağlıyor. Asaf Erdemli, “Bu İşte Bir Terslik Var” adlı enstalasyonunda Türkiye’nin doğal ve kültürel mirasının simgelerinden ters laleyi, geri dönüştürülmüş metaller aracılığıyla yeniden yorumluyor. COP31 kapsamında özel olarak üretilen 31 adet ters lale heykelinden oluşan enstalasyon, üretim ve tüketim alışkanlıklarımızı sorgularken, atıl malzemelerin yeniden değer kazanmasına dikkat çekiyor. Sanatçı, geri dönüşümü yalnızca bir üretim yöntemi olarak değil, doğaya ve geleceğe karşı kolektif bir sorumluluk olarak ele alıyor. Berkan Baycan’ın “Observer” adlı video çalışmasında bakışın yönü değişiyor: İnsan doğayı izlerken doğa da insanın yaptıklarına tanıklık ediyor. İnsan merkezli düşünceyi sorgulayan eser, ziyaretçiyi doğadaki dönüşümün sorumluluğunu paylaşan bir aktör olarak kendi konumunu değerlendirmeye çağırıyor. Ceylan Sakin Dökmen’in “Güneş Ağacı”, “Rüzgara Kapıldım” ve “Ağıt Ağaç” adlı metal heykelleri, doğanın kırılganlığı ile yenilenme gücünü aynı yüzeyde buluşturuyor. Eserlerdeki çatlaklar ve boşluklar, kırılmanın izlerini taşırken yeniden oluşun ihtimalini de barındırıyor. Sanatçı, metalin sertliği üzerinden doğanın hassas dengelerine dikkat çekiyor. Gönül Nuhoğlu’nun “Dreaming Rhino” adlı çalışmasındaki uyuyan gergedan, iklim krizi karşısındaki kolektif kayıtsızlığın simgesine dönüşüyor. Eser, büyüyen tehditlerin gündelik yaşam içinde nasıl sıradanlaştığını sorgularken izleyiciyi kendi duyarsızlıklarıyla yüzleşmeye davet ediyor. İnsan doğaya baktığında yalnızca çevresini değil, kendi kökenlerini de görüyor. İsmet Doğan, “Kök-en” ve “Autos” serisinde insanın doğayla, geçmişiyle ve kendi varoluşuyla kurduğu bağı sorguluyor. Kökler, doğaya ait bir yaşam kaynağı olmanın yanı sıra hafızanın, kimliğin ve aidiyetin simgesi olarak beliriyor. İzleyiciyi kendi yansımasıyla eserin bir parçasına dönüştüren sanatçı, insanın doğayla bir bütün olduğunu hatırlatıyor. İklim krizinin doğayla kurduğumuz ilişkiyi yeniden düşünmeye zorladığı günümüzde, “Kök-en” temel bir soruyu gündeme getiriyor: İnsan, kendi köklerinden ne kadar uzaklaşabilir? Murat Uçar’ın eserleri, Türkiye tarihinde ilklere imza atmış 36 ismin yaşamına büyüteç aracılığıyla yakından bakmaya davet ediyor. Kolektif hafızayı şekillendiren öncü figürleri yeniden görünür kılan eserler, değişimin ardındaki insan hikâyelerini seçkinin odağına taşıyor.

items.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
items.summary: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
items.summaryTr: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
items.articleText: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost? - Published A major Microsoft outage has impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world. Services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot, are being restored almost 24 hours since issues first surfaced. Microsoft said the outage was not a cyber-security incident and was caused by a technical issue. It has apologised for the disruption. Here's what we know about the services affected and what went wrong. What happened? Some Microsoft 365 services have been affected by "connectivity problems" with problems reported in at least 74 countries. From late on Thursday, customers reported varying levels of access - many were unable to send or receive emails, view certain files or details on their calendar apps. But some users were able to use Teams, messaging and online meeting functions without issues. As of Friday afternoon, Microsoft said it had seen "encouraging recovery progress" in Europe and improvement in North America. The company added that it was focused on "addressing the remaining areas of disruption" but warned "some users may still experience intermittent issues". In a later statement, the company said it was continuing to see improvements "with email queues significantly reduced and approaching normal levels". The company attributed the ongoing outage to an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade. "We have addressed the underlying issue and continue to restore service to remaining customers and regions," it said on Friday. Will emails affected by the outage ever arrive? Although services are beginning to resume, Microsoft has warned of continued "intermittent access issues", meaning some users will still struggle to load their inboxes and could experience "delayed email delivery". In other words, it is not quite safe to assume every email you send is going to arrive in its intended recipient's inbox right away. Earlier, Microsoft said it would be extending the "timeout window" to 48 hours "to help protect delayed messages as delivery catches up". The email timeout window refers to the amount of time Outlook will wait to receive an email. When they do show up, the timestamp will be when they were delivered rather than when they were sent. Why has it taken so long to fix? Although email service Outlook appears to be resuming, the outage has so far lasted for more than 20 hours - in outage terms that is considered a long time. Prof James Ferryman from the University of Reading's department of computer science said the details the company has disclosed provide some clues. "What Microsoft has told us is that the part of its servers that sets up secure connections is getting swamped, and once that happens the server just stops answering," he said. "The trouble is that this kind of failure snowballs. "One server falls over, its work gets passed to the next one, and meanwhile huge numbers of phones and laptops keep trying to get back in. "You can't just turn it all back on at once. You have to bring it back bit by bit." The challenge is therefore not just fixing the fault, but managing the huge surge of devices trying to reconnect once services start coming back online. Gergely Orosz, a former leading software engineer at several major tech companies including Skype and Uber, said this could be the "most disruptive" business email outage "of all time". He said it was still difficult to know just how many people have been affected by the disruption, but added he "cannot recall" an outage over business email ever taking this long to return to normal. Australian cyber-security expert Troy Hunt told the BBC the outage could have far-reaching consequences. "Microsoft is a massive part of the internet backbone and reminds us how critical email still is. "Not only does this outage affect many people's ability to work but also things like the ability to communicate about appointments, purchase things that need verification, create or access accounts and services," he said. In a statement, Microsoft said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously. We are seeing broad recovery and stability across our services." How many people have been affected? More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps according to Microsoft's website. The full scale of the outage has not been confirmed. Microsoft 365 is used by companies worldwide and is expected to have a knock-on effect to other services. Tech giants OpenAI and Anthropic both earlier reported problems as a result of the outage. ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it was investigating an issue affecting its connections to Microsoft's services, which had caused some tools to not work as expected. From city governments in the US to Australian spy agencies, disruption across the globe has been widespread. Courts from Los Angeles to Texas earlier warned that communications might be delayed. In Canada, the public broadcaster CBC reported that a healthcare network running several hospitals in Toronto was experiencing email issues, but that patient care was not affected. The government of Japan also said its shared IT platform had been disrupted. Across the UK, GP surgeries, pharmacies, police and schools have been affected by the outage. Some GP surgeries had urged patients not to submit messages via their website while police forces were also earlier asking the public to call if they want to make a report. Additional reporting by Henry Moore Get in touch Have you or your business been affected by the outage?

items.summary: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
items.summaryTr: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
items.articleText: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own - Published Pope Leo XIV has celebrated Mass near the Peruvian city where he made his name as a compassionate bishop who worked closely with poor and migrant communities. The ceremony was held on Friday at a park in Pimentel, about 10km (six miles) from Chiclayo in northern Peru as part of his tour of Latin America. The Vatican estimates more than 1.5 million people gathered to welcome the pontiff. "Thank you for your affection, support and prayers," the Pope told followers. "Especially for my health during this time of trial which, with God's help, I am overcoming," he added, referencing the surgery he had for lung cancer which took place just weeks ago. Some of the crowd arrived 12 hours in advance to wait in vigil before the Mass began. "We spent the night praying, alongside family, excited to welcome the Pope from Chiclayo," said Isa Orderique. Many came from across Peru and even neighbouring countries to attend. Merli Cruz Guerrero, from an area near the Ecuadorean border, travelled several hours by bus to attend. She also spent the entire night waiting. Of all the events the Pope has attended so far during his visit to Peru, this felt particularly emotional. The crowd fell into a hushed silence as the pontiff's motorcade approached. They waited eagerly for his arrival despite spending long hours out in the open with the temperature pushing past 30C. For many living here, the fact that the Pope worked extensively in this region before becoming the head of the Catholic Church has put them in the spotlight. "The Pope has come home and Chiclayo is celebrating," said Lisbeth Díaz, a teacher who worked with Pope Leo when he served as the city's bishop between 2015 and 2023. Peru is the longest stop on the first tour of Latin America by the pontiff, who was elected in May 2025. The trip has also taken in Argentina and Uruguay, but his time in this country carries particular significance. The Pope not only lived in Peru for long periods between 1985 and 2023 but also became a citizen of the country in 2015, forging close ties with local communities. Around Chiclayo, it is hard to meet anyone who doesn't claim to be a friend of the Pope or have a special anecdote about him. Some recall how he would enjoy sampling Peruvian delicacies at El Trébol, a restaurant next to the city's cathedral. Others remember his love of tennis. But for many it's the more serious moments of his time here, such as helping launch soup kitchens during the Covid-19 pandemic, or wading through deep waters on horseback when floods hit the area. Several of these images are on display in a small museum dedicated to him at the entrance to the bishop's residence. But for the city, and for a country that calls him the "Peruvian Pope", his return home means much more than a collection of photographs and anecdotes. "It is the return of the man who brought Peruvians closer to the Church," said Samuel David Miranda Atoche, a local parish priest from Chiclayo who was ordained by the Pope back when he was still the bishop and known under his birth name of Robert Prevost. And it is not just local people he connected with, according to Díaz, who came to Chiclayo from Venezuela. "It was difficult for him to see so many migrants living on the streets," she added, recalling the time when large numbers of Venezuelans came through Chiclayo escaping the political and economic crisis in their home country. "So, he got in touch with the migration authorities and coordinated with other organisations to speed up the paperwork needed for many of us to obtain legal residency and work permits." - Who is Robert Prevost, the new Pope Leo XIV? - Published9 May 2025 Robert Prevost's time here as bishop also involved difficult decisions, such as having to deal with the controversy and scandal surrounding the dissolution of Sodalitium of Christian Life, a Peruvian Catholic organisation that had faced decades of sexual abuse allegations. "If there is one thing Bishop Prevost worked for here," he added, referring to the Pope by his previous title, "it was unity". Normally, 800,000 people live in the city and its surrounding area, but estimates say the Pope's visit has caused that to double. Local businesses have been capitalising on the Pope's popularity to boost sales and hotels have sharply increased their nightly room rates. items.articleTextTr: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own - Published Pope Leo XIV has celebrated Mass near the Peruvian city where he made his name as a compassionate bishop who worked closely with poor and migrant communities. The ceremony was held on Friday at a park in Pimentel, about 10km (six miles) from Chiclayo in northern Peru as part of his tour of Latin America. The Vatican estimates more than 1.5 million people gathered to welcome the pontiff. "Thank you for your affection, support and prayers," the Pope told followers. "Especially for my health during this time of trial which, with God's help, I am overcoming," he added, referencing the surgery he had for lung cancer which took place just weeks ago. Some of the crowd arrived 12 hours in advance to wait in vigil before the Mass began. "We spent the night praying, alongside family, excited to welcome the Pope from Chiclayo," said Isa Orderique. Many came from across Peru and even neighbouring countries to attend. Merli Cruz Guerrero, from an area near the Ecuadorean border, travelled several hours by bus to attend. She also spent the entire night waiting. Of all the events the Pope has attended so far during his visit to Peru, this felt particularly emotional. The crowd fell into a hushed silence as the pontiff's motorcade approached. They waited eagerly for his arrival despite spending long hours out in the open with the temperature pushing past 30C. For many living here, the fact that the Pope worked extensively in this region before becoming the head of the Catholic Church has put them in the spotlight. "The Pope has come home and Chiclayo is celebrating," said Lisbeth Díaz, a teacher who worked with Pope Leo when he served as the city's bishop between 2015 and 2023. Peru is the longest stop on the first tour of Latin America by the pontiff, who was elected in May 2025. The trip has also taken in Argentina and Uruguay, but his time in this country carries particular significance. The Pope not only lived in Peru for long periods between 1985 and 2023 but also became a citizen of the country in 2015, forging close ties with local communities. Some recall how he would enjoy sampling Peruvian delicacies at El Trébol, a restaurant next to the city's cathedral. Others remember his love of tennis. But for many it's the more serious moments of his time here, such as helping launch soup kitchens during the Covid-19 pandemic, or wading through deep waters on horseback when floods hit the area. Several of these images are on display in a small museum dedicated to him at the entrance to the bishop's residence. items.titleTr: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
items.summaryTr: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.
items.articleText: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit. Metaplanet swung to a $170 million net loss in the first nine months of 2026, hit by a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings and a loss on the sale of 10,000 coins to demonstrate its ability to raise cash. The Japanese company, the world’s second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin (BTC) holder, posted a net loss of 27.16 billion yen (about $170 million), compared with a profit of 13.53 billion yen ($84.6 million) in the same period last year. A 19.17 billion yen ($119.8 million) loss on the Bitcoin sale and an 8.04 billion yen ($50.3 million) loss from a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings outweighed gains in the operating business. Over the quarter, Metaplanet sold the 10,000 BTC for 124.7 billion yen and temporarily held the proceeds in cash, stablecoins and other liquid assets. It then spent 149.9 billion yen to buy 11,000 BTC, paying 9.3% more per coin on average. The company said the sale was meant to show rating agencies and bond investors that it could turn its Bitcoin into cash to meet financing obligations. At the end of September, holdings rose by a net 1,000 coins to 44,000 BTC. Top 10 largest Bitcoin treasury companies. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.NET Metaplanet borrowed against its Bitcoin holdings during the quarter, increasing the amount it owed under the credit line to $649.5 million at the end of September from $414 million at the end of June. The company said it funded Bitcoin purchases from the second quarter onward with money borrowed under the credit line, proceeds from bond sales and the exercise of stock acquisition rights, and revenue from its Bitcoin options business. Metaplanet’s interest expense rose 56% from the previous quarter to 1.36 billion yen ($8.5 million). Short-term borrowings and bonds payable totaled 110.5 billion yen ($691 million) at the end of September. For the nine months through September, revenue rose 30.5% to 5.9 billion yen ($36.9 million), while operating profit increased 26.5% to 3.48 billion yen ($21.8 million). The company cut its full-year revenue forecast to 6.5 billion yen ($40.6 million) from 16 billion yen ($100 million). Related: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal Bitcoin treasury companies face pressure from falling prices, index removals Metaplanet’s earnings come as Bitcoin treasury companies face mounting pressure from incoming stock index removals and falling Bitcoin prices. Index provider MSCI confirmed Wednesday that Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi would be removed from its equity indexes at the Nov. 30 market close, potentially prompting funds that track those benchmarks to sell the shares. JPMorgan previously estimated that Strategy’s removal could result in roughly $2.8 billion in selling pressure from MSCI-linked funds. Bitcoin fell below $70,000 on Friday and was trading around $68,600 as of 4:51 p.m. UTC, down about 9% over the previous week, according to CoinGecko data. items.title: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
items.articleText: Release Number 9325-26 CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets November 13, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced that it has filed a lawsuit against Arkansas to block the state’s attempts to halt event-contract trading and impose up to hundreds of millions of dollars in civil penalties on CFTC-registered exchanges. Arkansas is bringing a civil enforcement against Kalshi in state court, a CFTC-designated contract market. Arkansas’s efforts to obstruct the functions of CFTC-registered exchanges operating lawfully under the Commodity Exchange Act are preempted by federal law. “As prediction markets continue to prove their value in being useful for risk management and providing the public with valuable information about the future, Arkansas seeks to shut down event contracts ranging from sports and politics to other important world events,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The CFTC will continue to defend its sole jurisdiction over these federally regulated markets as granted by Congress under the Commodity Exchange Act, and the Commission will not let state interference thwart its regulatory efforts and destroy federally regulated markets.” Arkansas is the 11th state the CFTC has sued to vindicate federal sovereign interests. The CFTC has also submitted amicus briefs in four federal Courts of Appeal and one state Supreme Court. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
items.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
items.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

items.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
items.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
items.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-
